values.name: Absorber
values.description: You attempt to absorb some of a target’s health. Make a melee attack. On a hit, the creature takes {dice} {type} damage. Half the damage done is restored by the user.

values.name: Turbofelsen
values.description: You smash into a target at high speed. As a bonus action, you can immediately move up to 10ft and make a melee attack against a creature in range without taking an attack of opportunity, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Säure
values.description: You create a stream of hot acid in a {shape}, centered on you. Creatures caught in the cone must make on a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, and half as much on a success.

values.name: Säurepanzer
values.description: You are surrounded by a shield of thick acid for the duration. During this time, your AC increases by 2, and any creature that hits you with a melee attack must succeed on a {save} or take {dice} {type} damage.

values.name: Säurespeier
values.description: You spit a spray of acidic fluid that works to melt away a creature's defense. Make a ranged attack against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the target must make a {save}. On a failure, the target's AC is reduced by 1 for the duration. This decrease may be stacked on a creature, up to a maximum of -3 to its AC.

values.name: Akrobatik
values.description: You nimbly attack a target with acrobatic prowess. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If you are holding an item when you activate this move, the damage is halved.

values.name: Akupressur
values.description: You apply pressure to different stress points on your body, boosting a random ability for the duration. When activating this move, roll a d6 and gain the following boost based on the result. When activated on subsequent turns, any previous effect ends.

values.name: Aero-Ass
values.description: You dive at a creature with such speed that it is impossible for them to avoid. This move is guaranteed to hit for {dice} {type} damage, unless during the invulnerable stage of Fly, Dig, Bounce, Dive, etc. moves.

values.name: Luftstoß
values.description: You shoot out a powerful vortex of air that shreds through creatures. Any creature caught in a {shape}, 5 feet wide, must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, and half as much on a save.

values.name: Galanterie
values.description: As a bonus action, choose a creature in range that has not yet taken its turn in the current round. The target must immediately take its turn now, and return to normal initiative order in the next round.

values.name: Agilität
values.description: You hone your abilities and feel a surge of speed course through your veins. Increase your movement speed by 20 feet for the duration. Applicable to any movement type the creature has.

values.name: Windschnitt
values.description: You create a gust of razor-like wind to slash a creature. Make a ranged attack against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move scores a critical hit on 19 and 20.

values.name: Luftschnitt
values.description: You slash at a creature with a blade of sharp air. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 15 or higher, the target flinches.

values.name: Lockstimme
values.description: You use your angelic voice to confuse a target. Make a ranged attack against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage. On a hit, the target must make a {save} or become Confused.

values.name: Seitentausch
values.description: You use a strange psychic power to teleport yourself and one willing creature in range, switching places on the battlefield.

values.name: Amnesie
values.description: Your mind elevates to a new level of focus. Add +2 to any saving throw you make for the duration, but select one of your moves that is not Amnesia. You forget that move and cannot use it for the duration.

values.name: Ankerschuss
values.description: You attempt to entangle a target with your anchor chain while attacking. Choose a target within range and make a ranged attack on that creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the target becomes restrained and cannot flee or be switched out.  The target may make a {save} at the beginning of each of its turns to attempt to release themselves from the chain.

values.name: Antik-Kraft
values.description: You lash out with unknown inner power. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, all of your ability scores go up by 1 while you remain in battle. This move can be stacked for a maximum of +5 to all ability scores.

values.name: Apfelsäure
values.description: You douse the area in the acid of tart apples. Targets in the area must make a {save}. A creature takes {dice} {type} damage on failure, half on success. Every creature that fails the save also suffers -2 to DEX and CON saving throws until the end of the encounter or until withdrawn. This effect may stack up to three times on the same creature.

values.name: Aqua Cutter
values.description: You expel pressurized water to cut the target like a blade. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This attack scores a critical hit on natural attack rolls of 19 or 20.

values.name: Wasserdüse
values.description: You lunge at a creature with incredible speed. Choose a target within 10 feet of you. A burst of water propels you towards that creature, avoiding all attacks of opportunity. Make a melee attack on that creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Wasserring
values.description: You surround yourself with a veil of healing water. At the end of each of your turns, as long as you hold concentration, regain a number of hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

values.name: Aqua Step
values.description: You charge at your target with fluid dance steps. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. At the end of your turn, regardless of whether you hit, your movement speed increases by 10ft until the end of your next turn.

values.name: Nassschweif
values.description: You lash out with your tail to strike a creature. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Armstoß
values.description: You unleash a flurry of fists on a creature. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 {type} damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.

values.name: Armor Cannon
values.description: You shoot your own armor out as blazing projectiles. Make a ranged attack against a target in range, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Until the end of your next turn, all attacks made against you have advantage, and you have disadvantage on all CON saves.

values.name: Aromakur
values.description: You release a pleasant aroma that empowers your allies. All allies within 10 feet of you are cured of all negative status ailments.

values.name: Duftwolke
values.description: You release an aroma that inspires your allies. When you activate this move, you and any ally within 5 feet of you may add a d4 to any saving throw they make for the duration.
values.higherLevels: The bonus dice roll for this move changes to a 1d6 at level 10

values.name: Zuschuss
values.description: You call upon the help of another active creature in your party. When activating this Move, another creature may immediately take an action in place of your own, if you have not already taken an action this turn.

values.name: Gewissheit
values.description: You strike a creature where it already hurts. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target has already taken any damage since the end of your last turn, double the damage you deal.

values.name: Erstauner
values.description: You startle a creature with a loud shout . Make a ranged attack roll against a creature doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 15 or more, the target flinches.
values.optional: Instead of a natural roll of 15 or higher, target must make a WIS save against your MOVE DC. On failure, the target flinches.

values.name: Astralfragmente
values.description: You send a frightful amount of small ghosts at a point within range. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered there makes a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful save.

values.name: Schlagbefehl
values.description: You summon your underlings to attack a target. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move scores a critical hit on rolls of 19 or 20.

values.name: Anziehung
values.description: As a reaction, when dealt damage by an attack, you may force the attacker to make a {save}. On a fail, the creature must roll the damage again and use the lower result.

values.name: Aurasphäre
values.description: You focus your aura into a concentrated blast that strikes a creature in range. This move is guaranteed to hit for {dice} {type} damage, except when targeting a creature in the invulnerable stages of Fly, Dig, Bounce, etc.

values.name: Aura-Rad
values.description:
You create a wheel of energy around yourself and charge at a creature in range. You can immediately move up to 5ft and make a melee attack against a creature in range, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If this attack hits, the next time Aura Wheel is used, you may move an additional 5ft. This effect stacks up to a total bonus movement of 20ft.

The damage type of this move is Electric when its user is in Full Belly Mode, and Dark when its user is in Hangry Mode.

values.name: Aurorastrahl
values.description: You send a concentrated beam of freezing ice at a single creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 15 or higher, the target has disadvantage on any attack it makes on its next turn.

values.name: Auroraschleier
values.description: You use the environment to create a shield of ice around your body. Only able to be activated while it is hailing, this move can be used as a bonus action to halve all damage dealt to you for three rounds.

values.name: Autotomie
values.description: You shed away part of your body to make yourself lighter and increase your speed. For the duration, your speed increases by 10 feet. This move may be stacked to a maximum speed increase of 30 feet.

values.name: Lawine
values.description: You send forth a heap of powerful snow to pummel a creature. Make a ranged attack on a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target has dealt any damage to you since the end of your last turn, double the damage you deal.

values.name: Axe Kick
values.description:
You leap into the air to slam your heel upon the target. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a miss, you take 1 damage.

On a successful hit, the target must succeed a {save} or become confused.

values.name: Kulleraugen
values.description: You quickly widen your eyes in an attempt to charm a creature, decreasing their will to fight. When you or an ally in range are targeted by a Move that requires an attack roll, you may use a reaction to impose disadvantage on the roll.

values.name: Bunker
values.description: You sense incoming danger and are able to quickly create a barrier to avoid it.  When targeted by an attack, you may automatically avoid taking damage on the first instance of this reaction. If Baneful Bunker was successful in avoiding a melee attack, the attacker becomes poisoned.  On future instances of this move in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful.

values.name: Barb Barrage
values.description: You launch a countless toxic barbs in all directions. Each creature in range must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage and becoming poisoned on a failed save. If the target is already poisoned, double your MOVE modifier when adding damage.

values.name: Stakkato
values.description: Make a ranged attack on a creature, rolling {dice} on a hit. You attack with a barrage of ranged strikes equal to the number shown. Each projectile deals {dice} {type} damage.
values.higherLevels: Each projectile that hits deals 1d6 at level 5, 2d4 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

values.name: Barriere
values.description: You create a transparent shield of psychic energy. While active, the barrier grants +2 to AC for you and any companions within 5 feet of you for the duration.

values.name: Stafette
values.description: As a bonus action, you may switch out, passing along all negative status effects and stat changes to the new creature. This includes existing battle effects from moves such as Substitute, Swords Dance, Ingrain, Aqua Ring, etc. Effects from moves that require concentration may also be transferred, with concentration now dependent on the new creature.

values.name: Schnabelkanone
values.description: You heat up your beak and strike out at a target. When you activate this move, you spend your action to charge up your beak. If you are hit with a melee attack before the action of your next turn, the target is burned. On your next turn, spend an action to make a melee attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Prügler
values.description: You use strength in numbers to attack a creature. Make a melee attack on a creature, and an additional attack for any other conscious creature your trainer is currently carrying, dealing {dice} {type} damage on each hit.

values.name: Gigantenstoß
values.description: You bash with your gigantic shield. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target was dynamaxed, double the overall damage.

values.name: Gigantenhieb
values.description: You slash with your gigantic sword. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target was dynamaxed, double the overall damage.

values.name: Rülpser
values.description: You let out a damaging belch at a creature in range. Force the creature to make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If you are holding a berry when activating this move, you may consume it and force the target to automatically fail the saving throw.

values.name: Bauchtrommel
values.description: You sacrifice health for attack. When using this move, decrease your current HP by half your maximum, but increase your Strength score by 10 while you remain in battle. The effect ends if your current HP rises above half your maximum.

values.name: Offerte
values.description: As a bonus action, you may pass your held item to a willing creature in range, if the target is not currently holding an item.

values.name: Geduld
values.description: You embrace the damage done to you, waiting for your time to strike. Use your attack action to activate this move, and keep track of all damage done to you before your next turn. On your next turn, you use your action to lash out at a target with a normal ranged attack, striking them for double the amount of typeless damage you took on a successful hit. At 10th Level, you can choose to hold Bide for a second turn for the chance to add additional damage to the attack.
values.higherLevels: You may continue to stockpile damage for 2 turns at level 10 and above.

values.name: Klammergriff
values.description: You attempt to grapple a target into submission. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and is grappled. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a {save}. While a creature is grappled, you may continue this move, as a bonus action, to do an automatic 1d4 {type} damage without having to make an attack roll.

values.name: Biss
values.description: You sink your teeth into a target creature. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a successful hit. On natural attack rolls of 19 or 20, the target flinches
values.optional: Instead of a natural roll of 19 or higher, the target must make a CON save against your MOVE DC. On failure, the target flinches.

values.name: Bitter Blade
values.description: You focus your bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Half of the damage dealt is restored to the user.

values.name: Bitter Malice
values.description: You attack with spine-chilling resentment. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the target must succeed a {save} or have disadvantage on any attack it makes on its next turn.

values.name: Lohekanonade
values.description: Explosive projectiles rain down upon creatures in a 10 foot radius, centered on a point within range. Any creature caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail and half as much on a success. This move saps you of energy, and may not activate it again until after the end of your next turn.

values.name: Feuerfeger
values.description: Flames burst from your feet as you deliver a powerful kick. Make a melee attack on a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 18 or more, the target is burned. This move scores a critical hit on 19s and 20s.

values.name: Bleakwind Storm
values.description:
You create a storm with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble with the size of a 40-foot-cube centered on a point in range. Each enemy creature in the area makes a {save}. On a failed save, it takes {dice} {type} damage. On a successful save, it takes half the damage. The area is considered Difficult Terrain for enemy creatures.

A creature also makes that save if it enters the area or ends it turn there. A creature makes that save only once per turn.

When used during the rain, creatures have disadvantage on the save.

values.name: Blizzard
values.description: Icy clouds form overhead and pelt the ground with hail and snow, centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in a 30 ft radius, centered on a point within range, must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Targets that fail the save by 5 or more become frozen.

values.name: Rückentzug
values.description: If a creature within range attempts to flee or switch out, you may use your reaction to stop it dead in its tracks, keeping this from happening.

values.name: Blood Moon
values.description: You unleash the full brunt of your spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. Choose a creature in range to make a {save}. The creature takes {dice} {type} damage on a hit on a failed save, or half damage on a successful save. This move cannot be used on consecutive turns by the same creature.

values.name: Blauflammen
values.description: You unleash an intense and beautiful line of blue flames in a {shape}, 5 feet wide. Any creature caught in the line must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a creature fails the save by 5 or more, they are burned.

values.name: Body Press
values.description: You slam into your target with your body. Make a melee attack against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If your size is at least one category greater than the target's size, deal an additional MOVE {type} damage.

values.name: Bodyslam
values.description: You thrust yourself towards a creature in an attempt to crush them with your physical size. Make a melee attack on a target. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage, and must succeed on a {save} or be knocked prone.

values.name: Schockschnabel
values.description: You stab the target with an electrified beak. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target did not use an attacking move on its last turn, double the MOVE damage.

values.name: Blitzschlag
values.description: You send down a powerful strike of lightning from the heavens, surrounding an area of the battlefield with surging electricity. Any creature caught in a 20 foot radius, centered on a point within range, must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a creature fails the save by 5 or more, it becomes paralyzed.

values.name: Knochenkeule
values.description: You strike a creature with a club of bone, doing {dice} {type} damage on a successful hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target flinches.

values.name: Knochenhatz
values.description: You rush forward to deliver a series of hard hits against a target. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 {type} damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.

values.name: Knochmerang
values.description: You throw a boomerang and make two ranged attacks against a target. On each successful hit, do {dice} {type} damage.

values.name: Überschallknall
values.description: You create a deafening, explosive sound that damages all creatures within 20 feet of you. Force any creature in range to make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

values.name: Sprungfeder
values.description: When you activate this move, you use 10 feet of your movement to bounce upwards and disappear, remaining in an invulnerable state until your next turn. During this time, you are immune to the damage and effects of any move. If you have no remaining movement or are grappled/restrained before activating this move, the move fails. On your next turn, as an action, you reappear and attempt to slam down on top of a creature. Make a melee attack roll on a creature in range, with advantage, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 15 or more, the target is paralyzed.

values.name: Zweigstoß
values.description: You poke a creature with a sharply pointed branch. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Sturzflug
values.description: You tuck in your wings and dive at a creature. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, you also take a quarter of the total (rounded down) in typeless recoil damage.

values.name: Breitseite
values.description: You swing your tail wildly around you. All creatures within 5ft must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, and half as much on a success. Creatures that fail the saving throw also have disadvantage on all of their attacks until the end of their next turn.

values.name: Durchbruch
values.description: You strike out with a powerful and focused punch. Make a melee attack roll on a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move ignores the effects of moves that would reduce its damage (Harden, Reflect, etc.)

values.name: Lake
values.description: You send a harsh blast of salt water at a creature. Make a ranged attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target has less that 50% of its max HP, double the damage dealt.

values.name: Wirbler
values.description: You swing your arms around violently, attacking anything within 5 feet of you. All creatures in range must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

values.name: Blubber
values.description: You shoot a series of quickly moving bubbles at a target. Make three ranged attacks, doing {dice} {type} damage on each successful hit.

values.name: Blubbstrahl
values.description: You shoot a concentrated stream of bubbles at a single creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 19 or 20, the target's speed is halved until the end of their next turn.

values.name: Käferbiss
values.description: You lash out and bite a target. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target is holding a berry when you hit, you immediately eat it and gain its effect.

values.name: Käfergebrumm
values.description: You vibrate your wings, creating a harsh sound that damages any creature in range. All creatures within 20 feet of you must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail. If a creature fails the save by 5 or more, they have disadvantage on their next attack.

values.name: Protzer
values.description: You pump yourself up, increasing your adrenaline. For the next minute, choose to add +1 to your attack rolls OR +1 to AC. This move can be stacked to a maximum of +5 of the initial choice.

values.name: Dampfwalze
values.description: You strike the ground so hard that it ripples out from you in a {shape}. Any creature caught in the area must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Raised creatures are immune to the effects and damage of this move.

values.name: Patronenhieb
values.description: You strike with a punch that is quick as a bullet. Choose a target within 10 feet of you. You rush forward to slam a fist into the creature, avoiding all attacks of opportunity. Make a melee attack on that creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Kugelsaat
values.description: Your fire a series of high-speed seeds at a creature. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 {type} damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.

values.name: Ausbrennen
values.description: You use up all the fire energy you have to inflict massive damage in a {shape}, centered on you. Creatures within the area must make a {save}. On a failure, the creature take {dice} {type} damage and become burned. On a success, they take half as much damage without being burned. After using this move, the user burns itself out and loses its fire-typing for the remainder of combat. Dual-type fire Pokémon change to their single other type, and single-type Pokémon become typeless, losing STAB and all vulnerabilites, resistances, and immunities.

values.name: Flammenschild
values.description:
Your intensely hot fur burns any attacker that makes direct contact. Flames wreathe your body for the duration, shedding Bright Light in a 10ft radius and Dim Light for an additional 10ft.

Whenever a creature hits you with a melee attack roll, the bulwark erupts with flame. The attacker takes {dice} {type} damage.

values.name: Neidflammen
values.description:
You attack all creatures in a {shape} with energy from jealousy. All creatures in the area must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage and becoming burned on failure, or on success only taking half the damage.

Creatures who are currently benefiting from an increase to their AC, STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, or CHA have disadvantage on the save.

values.name: Gedankengut
values.description: You clear your mind of all distractions. For the duration, double your STAB bonus when dealing damage of your type.

values.name: Tarnung
values.description: You blend in with your surroundings, replacing your current type with a new type. The type is dependent on the environment, and up to the DM's discretion. Some examples are included below.

values.name: Liebreiz
values.description: You attempt to charm a creature into pulling its punches. When hit by an attack from a creature of the opposite gender, you may use a reaction to force it to make a {save}. On a failure, the attack does not hit.

values.name: Ceaseless Edge
values.description:
You slash your shell blade and splinter debris over the field. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

On a successful hit, spikes cover the ground in a 10-foot square centered on the target, turning it into Difficult Terrain for 1 minute. When the spikes appear, each creature standing in the area except for the creature using this move must succeed on a {save} or suffer 1d10 {type} damage. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed or take the damage.

values.name: Ladevorgang
values.description: Electricity surges through your body, charging up for your next attack. Until your next turn, boost your AC by 2. On your next turn, double your STAB bonus when dealing damage of your type.

values.name: Ladestrahl
values.description: You send a beam of electric energy at a creature that has a chance to power you up. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 10 or higher and the attack hits, double your MOVE modifier for the damage of this move and any other move you activate before the end of your next turn.

values.name: Charme
values.description: You attempt to charm a creature, sharply decreasing its attack. A target you choose in range must make a {save}. On a fail, the target adds -2 to all attack rolls against you for the duration.
values.higherLevels: The target adds -3 at level 5, -4 at level 10, and -5 at level 17.

values.name: Geschwätz
values.description: You shout a series of disorienting words at a creature, scrambling their senses. Make a ranged attack. On a hit, deal {dice} {type} damage and cause the target to become confused.

values.name: Chilling Water
values.description: You shower a creature with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the target must succeed a {save} or have disadvantage on any attack it makes on its next turn.

values.name: Chilly Reception
values.description: You tell a chillingly bad joke. The weather is changed to Snow for 5 rounds. After this move is activated, the trainer must switch out the user as a free action (before they get booed off the stage!).

values.name: Zermürben
values.description: You wait for an opening, striking with speed when the moment is right. Ignoring any boosts to the AC of a target, make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Chloroblast
values.description: You launch your amassed chlorophyll in a {shape} in front of you. You take typeless damage equal to one half of your maximum HP. Creatures in the area must make a {save}. On failure, a creature takes {dice} {type} damage, or half on success.

values.name: Überkopfwurf
values.description: You swing the target around and throw it as hard as you can, away from the battlefield. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. In wild battles, the target takes the damage and flees from battle if its level is lower than that of the user. In trainer battles, the target takes the damage and must be immediately switched out for another creature in the trainer's party, if any remain.

values.name: Schnapper
values.description: You clamp down on a target, attempting to deal damage and keep them in place. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and is grappled. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to pry itself away with a {save}. As long as the target is grappled on your subsequent turns, this move can be activated again as a bonus action with an automatic hit, dealing 1d6 {type} damage.

values.name: Schuppenrasseln
values.description: You slam your scaled hands together to create an intense, sound-based shockwave in a {shape} in front of you. Any creature caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Creatures that fail the save by 5 or more reduce their AC by 1 for the remainder of combat.

values.name: Seelentanz
values.description: You clap your scaled hands together to strengthen yourself. Take 3d6 typeless damage, and in exchange gain +1 to attack rolls, +1 to AC, and +1 to damage rolls for the remainder of the encounter or until switched out of combat. This can be stacked up to five times for a total bonus of +5 each.

values.name: Klärsmog
values.description: You throw a clump of special mud that has the power to remove all stat changes from a target. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, any stat changes affecting the target since the beginning of battle are reset.

values.name: Nahkampf
values.description: You get in close for a devastating strike, sacrificing your defenses. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After activating this move, the target has advantage on any attack it makes against you before the beginning of your next turn.

values.name: Coaching
values.description: You coach an ally on how to maximize their offense and defense. Choose one ally other than yourself within 60 feet who can hear you. For the duration, that ally can add +1 to their attack rolls and +1 to their AC.
values.higherLevels: The bonus for this move changes to +2 at level 10.

values.name: Einrollen
values.description: You coil up and concentrate your power. For the duration, gain +1 to your attack rolls, damage rolls, and AC.

values.name: Collision Course
values.description:
You crash into the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. Make a melee attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the target must make a {save} or be knocked prone.

If the target is vulnurable to this damage, the damage is increased by MOVE.

values.name: Kometenhieb
values.description: You strike out with a lightning fast punch. Make a melee attack roll. The target takes {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 {type} damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.

values.name: Vertrauenssache
values.description: You whisper an untold secret into the mind of a creature in range. The target must make a {save}, becoming confused on a failure.

values.name: Konfusstrahl
values.description: You target a creature in range with a sinister ray of ghostly light. Make a ranged attack against a creature. On a hit, they become confused.

values.name: Konfusion
values.description: You attempt to enter the mind of a target and cause confusion. Make a ranged attack on a creature in range. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage. If the natural attack roll is 15 or more, the target becomes confused.
values.optional: Instead of a roll of 15 or higher, the target must make a WIS save against your MOVE DC. On failure, the target becomes confused.

values.name: Umklammerung
values.description: You wrap yourself around a creature, trying to squeeze the life from them. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and is grappled. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a {save}. As long as the target is grappled on your subsequent turns, this move can be activated again as a bonus action with an automatic hit, dealing 1d4 {type} damage.

values.name: Umwandlung
values.description: Until the beginning of your next turn, take on a new type for resistances/vulnerabilities/immunities equal to one of the types of a move you currently know.

values.name: Umwandlung2
values.description: If you took damage from an attack since the end of your last turn, you may use a bonus action to change your type to any type that is resistant or immune to the type of move used against you. This effect lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

values.name: Imitator
values.description: You mimic a target that you can see, in range. When you activate this move, choose a target in range and fully execute the most recent move used by the creature, using your own ability scores, level, and typing for saving throw DC, attack, and damage.
values.optional:
This move may also copy a DnD spell. The pokemon's level determines the maximum spell level that can be copied.

| Pokemon Level | Spell Level |
| --- | --- |
| 1-4 | 2 |
| 5-9 | 3 |
| 10-16 | 4 |
| 17-20 | 5 |

values.name: Sanktionskern
values.description: You send a focused laser that scorches a 'Z' pattern on a target. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, force the target to make a {save}, losing all effects of its abilities on a failure, until it is switched out.

values.name: Korrosionsgas
values.description:
You surround yourself and everything within a {shape} of you in highly acidic gas. The gas lasts for the duration or until strong wind (such as the one created by Gust) disperses it. Its area is Heavily Obscured.

All Held Berries in the area instantly melt away. Each non-poison-type creature that starts its turn in the sphere must succeed on a {save}. On failure, until the end of the current turn, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks; additionally, if the creature's SR is below 15, then it cannot benefit from Held Items.

values.name: Comeuppance
values.description: When you are hit by a melee attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against the creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a successful hit.

values.name: Kosmik-Kraft
values.description: You call upon a mystic force to come to your aid. For the duration, you have advantage on all saving throws.

values.name: Watteschild
values.description: You protect yourself by wrapping your body up in thick, soft cotton. For the duration, boost your AC by +2.

values.name: Baumwollsaat
values.description: You unleash spores of thick cotton that covers the target. Force a target in range to make a {save}. On a fail, the target’s speed is reduced by 10 for the duration. If this reduction in speed causes their speed to be 0, they are restrained for the duration.

values.name: Konter
values.description: When you are hit by a melee attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against the creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a successful hit.

values.name: Seitenwechsel
values.description: When another creature you can see in range performs a non-damaging move that requires one or more targets (possibly including self), you may force that creature to make a {save}. On failure, you choose the target(s) of the move.
values.optional: This move may also apply to spells. Spells cast at the sixth level or higher cannot be a target of Court Change.

values.name: Bezirzer
values.description: You strike out with quick and sticky hands. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a successful attack, you steal the creatures held item if you are not currently holding one.

values.name: Krabbhammer
values.description: You slam down onto a creature with a heavy claw. Make a melee attack roll on a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move scores a critical hit on rolls of 19 or 20.

values.name: Trickschutz
values.description: You summon forth a mysterious power that blocks an incoming status condition. When you or an ally within 5 feet of you are subject to a status condition from a move, you may use your reaction to nullify the condition.

values.name: Kreuzhieb
values.description: You crush a creature with a strong sideways strike. Make a melee attack against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Cross Chop results in a critical hit on 19s and 20s.

values.name: Giftstreich
values.description: You slash at a creature with a poisonous strike. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the attack is treated as a critical hit and the target is poisoned.

values.name: Knirscher
values.description: You unleash a powerful blow that has a chance to temporarily lower a target’s defense. Make a melee attack against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 18 or higher, the target’s AC is decreased by 1 for the remainder of combat. This decrease may be stacked, up to a maximum of -5 to AC.

values.name: Zermalmklaue
values.description: You strike out with powerful claws. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 15 or more, your next attack on the same target is rolled at advantage.

values.name: Quetschgriff
values.description: You clasp your hands around a creature for a crushing blow. Make a melee attack against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage and grappling the target on a hit. If the target is above 50% of its maximum health, add your proficiency bonus to the damage roll.

values.name: Fluch
values.description:
This Move has a different effect based on your creature type.

If you are ghost-type: You attempt to put a curse on a creature. Force a target in range to make a {save}. On a fail, the target is cursed. You take {dice} damage initially and the target takes {dice} {type} damage at the end of each of its turns for the duration.

If you are any other type: You place a curse on yourself. For the duration, your STR and CON scores increase by 2, but your DEX score decreases by 4.

values.name: Zerschneider
values.description: You lash out at a target with vine or claw or blade. Make a melee attack roll on a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a successful hit.

values.name: Finsteraura
values.description: You target a creature with a dark aura filled with horrible thoughts. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 17 or higher, the target flinches.

values.name: Schlummerort
values.description: You send the minds of your creatures into a world of darkness, damaging them before putting them to sleep. All creatures within 30 feet of you must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage and falling asleep on a failure, or half as much without falling asleep on a success.

values.name: Dark Lariat
values.description: You dangerously swing both arms at a creature in range, ignoring any positive stat changes the target is affected with.  Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Zauberschein
values.description: You emit a powerful flash that damages all creatures in range. Creatures within 20 feet of you must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

values.name: Verzierung
values.description: You decorate the target. The target has advantage on attack rolls. When the target takes damage, it must make a CON save. The DC equals 10 or half the damage taken (round down), whichever number is higher, up to a maximum DC of 30. On failure, the decorate effect ends immediately.

values.name: Blockbefehl
values.description: You summon forth your underlings to form a natural shield in front of you. For the duration, as long as you keep your concentration, gain +1 to your AC.
values.higherLevels: The AC boost for this move changes to +2 at level 5, +3 at level 10, and +4 at level 17.

values.name: Einigler
values.description: You curl up into a tight ball, increasing your defensive stance. Until your next turn, you gain + 4 to your AC and have resistance to normal attacks.

values.name: Auflockern
values.description: You summon a swift, magical breeze in a {shape}, centered on you, that sweeps away foggy weather and obstacles. When activating this move, any area of effect moves that are still active end immediately (Examples: Misty Terrain, Fog Cloud, Smog, etc.).

values.name: Abgangsbund
values.description: You create a dark, internal bond with a creature. Select a target in range, who must make a {save}. On a fail, half of any damage dealt to the user is also dealt as typeless damage to the target creature.

values.name: Scanner
values.description: You sense incoming danger and are able to quickly avoid it. When you are the recipient of the damage and/or effects of a move, you may automatically avoid the damage/effects on the first instance of this reaction. On future instances of this move in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful. This reaction may not be used to guard against the damage/effects that result from a natural 20 attack roll.

values.name: Diamantsturm
values.description: You stir up a massive storm of sharp diamonds in a 30 foot radius, centered on a point in range. When a creature enters the area for the first time on their turn, or begins their turn inside the area, they take {dice} {type} damage. The Diamond Storm lasts for 3 rounds. When you activate this move, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, your AC is increased by 2 while the Diamond Storm is active.

values.name: Schaufler
values.description: You burrow underground, disappearing from view before striking from underneath a target. When you activate this move, you use 10 feet of your movement to burrow underground (ignoring difficult terrain) and remain there until your next turn. During this time, you are immune to the damage and effects of any move. If you have no remaining movement or are grappled/restrained before activating this move, the move fails. On your next turn, you use your action to emerge from the ground and make a melee attack on a creature in range, with advantage, doing {dice} {type} damage on a successful hit. If the target has Tremorsense, the attack is not rolled with advantage.

values.name: Dire Claw
values.description: You lash out at your target with ruinous claws. Make a melee attack against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the creature must make a {save}. On failure, the target rolls a d6, gaining the status condition as follows:

values.name: Aussetzer
values.description: You attempt to disable a target, hindering its moves. Choose a target in range. The target must succeed on a {save}. On a failed save, the last Move it activated is unable to be used while you hold your concentration. (If this would end Solar Beam, Skull Bash, etc. during the charge phase of the Move, the Move automatically fails on the target's next turn).

values.name: Säuselstimme
values.description: You let out a charming cry, dealing emotional damage to any creature in range that can hear you. This move automatically hits for {dice} {type} damage unless a creature is in the invulnerable stages of Fly, Dig, Bounce, etc.
values.optional: Instead of automatically hitting, targets make a CHA save against your MOVE DC. On failure, they take full damage and have disadvantage on their next attack. On success, they take half damage.

values.name: Ladungsstoß
values.description: You let loose a flare of electricity in a {shape}, centered on you, striking all creatures around you. Creatures in the area must make a {save}. On a fail, a creature takes {dice} {type} damage. If a creature fails the save by 5 or more, it is paralyzed.

values.name: Taucher
values.description: When you activate this move, you use 10 feet of your movement to disappear into a magical space beneath your feet, remaining in an invulnerable state until your next turn. During this time, you are immune to the damage and effects of any move. If you have no remaining movement or are grappled/restrained before activating this move, the move fails. On your next turn, as an action, you reappear and attempt to attack a creature from below. Make a melee attack roll on a creature in range, with advantage, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Irrschlag
values.description: You strike out with a devastating punch. Make a melee attack roll on a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 18 or more, the target becomes confused. At level 17, a natural attack roll of 17 or more confuses the target.

values.name: Doodle
values.description: You capture the very essence of the target in a sketch. Choose a target in range. You and each ally within 5ft of you change one of your abilities to an ability on the target. If you know the target's abilities, you may choose which ability to copy; otherwise, you obtain a random ability from the target.

values.name: Kismetwunsch
values.description: You promise doom upon a creature. When you activate this move, select a target and make an attack roll. On a hit, at the beginning of the third round after you activate this move, the target takes {dice} damage of no specific type. If the target is switched out, the damage is done to the trainer's current active Pokémon.

values.name: Doppelschlag
values.description: You lash out quickly with two strikes. Make two melee attacks, dealing {dice} {type} damage on each hit.

values.name: Panzerfäuste
values.description: You punch twice with two devastating slams of your fist. Make two melee attack rolls, doing {dice} {type} damage on each successful hit. If any natural attack roll is 16 or higher, the target flinches.

values.name: Doppelkick
values.description: You strike twice with two devastating kicks. Make two melee attack rolls, doing {dice} {type} damage on each successful hit.

values.name: Duplexhieb
values.description: You reach out with quick slaps. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 {type} damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.

values.name: Doppelteam
values.description:
You create a duplicate image of yourself, 5 feet beside you. The image mimics you and attempt to fool your opponents into attacking it, instead.

When subject to any move (attack or saving throw / damaging or non-damaging) with an area of effect of 5 feet wide or less, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, the image absorbs the damage and/or effects of the attack and disappears. Creatures with Truesight bypass the effect of this move. If grappled or restrained by a creature while Double Team is active, Double Team has no effect. (Examples that would trigger the roll include Tackle, Thunder Wave, Rock Slide, etc.)
values.optional:
When this move is used again before the duplicate is consumed, an additional duplicate is created, up to a maximum of three duplicates.

With two duplicates, the attacker must roll a 5 or 6 on a d6 to hit the target. With three duplicates, the attacker must roll a 7 or 8 on a d8.

values.name: Risikotackle
values.description: You commit a massive attack against a creature. Make a melee attack against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit, but taking a quarter of the total damage (rounded down) in typeless recoil.

values.name: Double Shock
values.description:
You discharge all the electricity from your body to perform a high damage attack. Make a melee attack against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. You lose your electric typing unless terastallized; if mono-electric, your type becomes typeless.

This move may only be used if you have electric typing. You regain electric typing after a short rest.

values.name: Draco Meteor
values.description: You summon forth a meteor shower that rains down onto the battlefield. All creatures in a 10-foot-radius circle, centered on a point within range, must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a hit, or half as much on a save. After activating this move, your next attack is rolled at disadvantage. If that attack requires a saving throw, the target has advantage.

values.name: Draco Power
values.description: You channel the elemental energy within your ancestry to unleash a legendary power. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage and {dice} damage of one of the following types: fire, water, grass, electric.

values.name: Zenitstürmer
values.description: You soar upward and come crashing down towards a creature in range at tremendous speed. Make a melee attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Any creature within 10 feet of the target must make a {save} and take the same amount of damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. After activating this move, any attack roll that targets you until the beginning of your next turn is rolled with advantage.

values.name: Feuerodem
values.description: You release a powerful breath of energy in a {shape}. All targets caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, and half as much on a save. If a creature fails the save by 5 or more, it is paralyzed.

values.name: Drachenschrei
values.description:
You can use a bonus action to choose one ally other than yourself within 60 feet of you who can hear you. That ally's critical hit range is extended by 1 for the next minute or until they land a critical hit, whichever happens first. If the ally is Dragon-type, double the critical hit range extension. This bonus does not stack.

A critical hit range extension of 1 means a critical occurs on a natural 19 or 20.
values.higherLevels: The critical range extension changes to 2 at level 10.

values.name: Drachenklaue
values.description: You strike out with a powerful claw attack. Make a melee attack on a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Drachentanz
values.description: You perform a mystical dance, pumping yourself up. For the duration, double your proficiency bonus when making an attack.

values.name: Drachenpfeile
values.description: Make two ranged attacks against up to two creatures in range, each dealing {dice} {type} damage on hit.

values.name: Drachenhammer
values.description: You slam your head down like a hammer to attack a creature in range. Make a melee attack roll against the target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Hit or miss, any creatures within the line created by the attack (5 feet wide) must make a {save}, taking the same damage on a failure.

values.name: Drachenkräfte
values.description: You convert your life force into power. Make a ranged attack against a target in range, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. For every 20 HP you currently have (excluding temporary HP), deal an additional 1d6 {type} damage.

values.name: Drachenpuls
values.description: You open your mouth and send a shockwave of draconic energy at a target in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Drachenwut
values.description: You unleash a devastating flow of energy in a {shape}, 5 feet wide. Each creature caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, and half as much on a save.

values.name: Drachenstoß
values.description: You rush at a creature with overwhelming menace. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 17 or higher, the target flinches.

values.name: Drachenrute
values.description: You whip your dragon tail at a creature in an attempt to send them away. Make a melee attack roll against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage. In wild battles, the target takes the damage and flees from battle if its level is lower than that of the user. In trainer battles, the target takes the damage and must be immediately switched out for another creature in the trainer's party, if any remain.

values.name: Ableithieb
values.description: Your strike a target with an energy-draining punch. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit, gaining half the damage dealt (rounded down) in HP.

values.name: Diebeskuss
values.description: You attempt to zap the target's energy with a kiss. Make a melee attack roll on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. The user is then healed for half the damage dealt.

values.name: Traumfresser
values.description: You tap into a sleeping creature’s dreams, sucking from its energy pool. Instantly inflict {dice} {type} damage on a sleeping target in range, regaining half as many hitpoints to yourself. This move does not wake a sleeping creature.

values.name: Bohrschnabel
values.description: You hammer down on a target with a peck attack. Make a melee attack roll on a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a successful hit. Drill Peck scores a critical hit on 19s and 20s.

values.name: Schlagbohrer
values.description: You crash into a creature, spinning your body like a drill. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This attack scores a critical hit on 19s and 20s.

values.name: Trommelschläge
values.description:
You play your drum, controlling the drum's roots to attack all targets within 20 ft. When you use this move, you can designate any number of creatures you can see to be unaffected by it. An affected creature's speed is halved in the area, and when the creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a {save}. On a failed save, the creature takes {dice} {type} damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

For the duration or until concentration is broken, your speed is reduced to 0.

values.name: Doppelhieb
values.description: You lash out at a creature(s) with two quick strikes. Make two melee attack rolls, dealing {dice} {type} damage with each hit.

values.name: Doppelflügel
values.description: You slam a target with both of your wings. Make two melee attack rolls against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on each hit.

values.name: Dynamax-Kanone
values.description: You unleash a strong beam of pure energy. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target was dynamaxed, double the overall damage.

values.name: Wuchtschlag
values.description: You strike out with a twirling punch that confuses a creature. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, it also becomes confused.

values.name: Erdkräfte
values.description: You cause the ground beneath a creature to erupt with power. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 19 or 20, the next attack against the target is rolled at advantage.

values.name: Erdbeben
values.description: You create a tremor in the ground in a {shape}, centered on you. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail and be knocked prone. On a success, they take half as much damage and are not knocked prone. Creatures in range that are burrowed or in the invulnerable stage of Dig take double damage from this move. After the move is activated, the area becomes difficult terrain. Raised creatures are immune to the effects and damage of this move.

values.name: Widerhall
values.description: You release a shout that echoes across the battlefield towards a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Until the beginning of your next turn, if any other creature in range uses this move, they may double their damage dice on a hit. This multiplier can continue to stack to a maximum of 8x the damage dice, resetting if any of the attacks miss.

values.name: Mystowellen
values.description: Your body generates a strange pulsating sound that can disrupt creature's ability to attack. When you activate this move, any creature within 30 feet of you must make a {save}. Any creature that fails flinches for 1d4 rounds.

values.name: Schauderspruch
values.description: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. The target must make an {save}. On failure, moves the target makes cost 1 additional PP for the duration.
values.higherLevels: The additional PP cost becomes 2 at level 10.
values.optional: If the target is a spellcaster, spells cast by the target require 1 additional spell slot (2 at level 10).

values.name: Eierbombe
values.description: You hurl a hard egg at a creature that explodes on impact. Make a ranged attack on a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a successful hit.

values.name: Elektrofeld
values.description: You electrify the ground around you to create a static field of electricity. For 3 turns, no grounded creatures inside the area can be asleep. Grounded creatures are those that do not have a flying speed or Levitate, Magnet Rise, or similar ability. In addition, creatures may double their MOVE modifier on damage rolls from electric-type moves activated inside the area

values.name: Elektrifizierung
values.description: You suddenly surge with electric energy that transfers to your attacker. When hit by a melee attack, you may instantly use your reaction to force the attacker to make a {save}. On a failure, the attacking move's type is changed to electric.

values.name: Elektroball
values.description: You hurl an electric orb at a target in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Compare the target and user's highest speed type (walking, flying, etc.). If the user's speed is higher, roll the next tier's damage dice for this move. In the case of level 17 or higher, double the damage dice.

values.name: Electro Drift
values.description:
You race at ultrafast speeds with futuristic electricity. Make a melee attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the target cannot make attacks of opportunity against you until the end of your current turn.

If the target is vulnurable to this damage, the damage is increased by MOVE.

values.name: Stromstrahl
values.description: When you use this move, soak in electricity and prepare to unleash a devastating beam. On your next turn, if you keep your concentration, use an action to create a {shape} of electric energy, 5 feet wide. Any creature caught in the line must succeed on a {save} or take {dice} {type} damage on a fail and half as much on a save. If this move is used in the rain, double your MOVE modifier for damage and it can be used on the turn it is activated, without concentration.

values.name: Elektronetz
values.description: You unleash an electric net of web upon a creature. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit, and reducing the target's speed by 5 feet. The target can use an action on its turn remove any web from its body. A target whose speed is reduced to 0 is restrained.

values.name: Itemsperre
values.description: You surround a creature in range with a dark aura. Force a creature to make a {save}. On a failure, the target cannot gain the effect of any held item or trainer item given to it for the duration.

values.name: Glut
values.description: You hurl a ball of flame at a target within range. Make a ranged attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a successful hit. If the natural attack roll is 19 or 20, the target is burnt.
values.optional: Instead of a roll of 19 or higher, target makes a DEX save against your MOVE DC. On failure, the target is burnt.

values.name: Zugabe
values.description: After being targeted by a move, force a creature to make a {save} as a reaction. On a fail, no other move may be activated by the target creature until after the end of its next turn.
values.higherLevels: The number of turns the creature must use the move increases to 2 turns at level 10 and 3 turns at level 17.

values.name: Notsituation
values.description: When you activate this move, select a creature in range. the target must make a {save}. On a failure, the target’s current HP is reduced to be equal to your own. The hit point reduction can be no more than 5x the target's level. This move can not be used in the first round of combat.

values.name: Ausdauer
values.description: On an instance of taking damage that would otherwise cause you to faint, you may instead fall to 1HP on the first instance of this reaction. On future instances of this move in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful.

values.name: Energieball
values.description: You draw in power from nature in a concentrated ball that you send towards a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the next attack against the target is rolled at advantage.

values.name: Zwango
values.description: You dance with a strange rhythm that causes a creature to mimic you. Choose a target in range and force them to make a {save}. On a failure, choose one of their abilities to replace with one of your own for the duration.

values.name: Eruption
values.description: You spew hot magma in a {shape}. Any creature caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If you are at full health when activating this move, double your STAB bonus when dealing damage.

values.name: Esper Wing
values.description: You slash out with aura-enriched wings. Make a ranged attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Esper Wing results in a critical hit on 19s and 20s. With each successful hit from this move, increase your movement speed by 5ft until you are incapacitated, are switched out, or the combat ends (Maximum of +30ft to movement speed).

values.name: Unendynastrahlen
values.description: You unleash an overwhelmingly powerful beam of pure energy. Target a point within range. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point makes a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on fail, half on success. You become incapacitated until the end of your next turn.

values.name: Flächenmacht
values.description: You attack with psychic power. Choose a target in range. That target makes a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on failure or half damage on success. If you are under the effects of Psychic Terrain, then this move deals an additional 1d6 {type} damage, and you may choose any number of targets subject to the same terrain effect to make the save.

values.name: Explosion
values.description: You create a sphere of energy that packs a concentrated and devastating explosion. Choose a target within range and roll a d20. On a 20, the explosion goes off and all creatures within 5 feet of that point faint. On any other roll, the explosion fails to go off and this move has no effect. If the target's level is 10 more than your own, or their SR is 15, this move automatically fails.

values.name: Sondersensor
values.description: You create an irritating, damaging sound in the mind of a creature. Make a ranged attack roll against a creature in range, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 19 or 20, the target flinches.

values.name: Turbotempo
values.description: You rush to attack with incredible speed. As a bonus action, you can immediately move up to 10ft and make a melee attack against a creature in range without taking an attack of opportunity, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Fassade
values.description: You strike out at a creature with revenge. Make a melee attack roll against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If you are poisoned, paralyzed, or burned, double the dice for the damage.

values.name: Feenschloss
values.description: You summon forth a mystical power that locks down the battlefield. Creatures within 40 feet of you may not flee or be switched out on their next turn.

values.name: Feenbrise
values.description: You stir up vicious fairy winds that fly towards a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Mogelhieb
values.description: This attack can only be used on the first turn that the user has entered combat. Make a melee attack on a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit, causing the target to flinch.

values.name: Trugträne
values.description: You fake a creature out with superficial tears, lowering their defenses. When activating this move, a target must make a {save}. On a failure, all attack rolls against the target are given a +5 bonus until the end of your next turn.

values.name: Kniefalltrick
values.description: You pretend to bow your head, only to backstab your target at the last moment. The target must make a {save}. On failure, the target takes {dice} {type} damage, or half that damage on a successful save.

values.name: Trugschlag
values.description: You swipe at a creature but hold back power slightly. Make a melee attack against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If this attack would normally cause a creature to faint, it is reduced to 1HP instead.

values.name: Daunenreigen
values.description: You distract a creature in range with a beautiful dance. The target must make a {save}. On a fail, the target cannot add proficiency to its attack rolls for the duration.

values.name: Offenlegung
values.description: You fake out a creature before you strike. Make a melee attack against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If a creature attempts to use a Protect or Detect reaction against the damage, it fails.

values.name: Finte
values.description: You bring a creature close and hit it with a sucker punch. Make a melee attack on a creature, at advantage, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Stachelfinale
values.description: You lunge at a creature with a devastating sting attack. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If this attack causes the target to faint, double your ability modifier for attack rolls and damage on your next turn.

values.name: Launenlaser
values.description: You shoot a beam of light to inflict damage. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage. This move scores a critical hit on an attack roll of natural 17 or higher.

values.name: Feuerreigen
values.description: You dance and flap your wings, sending flames in a {shape}, centered on you. Anyone caught in the blaze must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a creature fails the save by 5 or more, double the MOVE modifier when adding damage

values.name: Brennender Zorn
values.description: You transform your wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. Choose any number of creatures in range to make a {save}. On failure, the creature takes {dice} {type} damage and flinches. On success, they take half the damage and do not flinch.

values.name: Fillet Away
values.description: You fillet yourself to sharpen your senses. You take 10 typeless damage. Your next attack has advantage, and your movement speed increases by 15ft until the start of your next turn.

values.name: Wagemut
values.description: You risk everything and use your own life force to damage a creature in range. When you activate this move, you faint, and force a target in range to make a {save}. The target takes an amount of fighting damage equal to your remaining HP (plus STAB if applicable) on a failure, or half as much on a success.

values.name: Feuersturm
values.description: Two pillars of raging hot flames explode out from you and leap towards up to two creatures in range. The creature(s) targeted must succeed on a {save} for each pillar, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Creatures that fail the save by 5 or more become burned.

values.name: Feuerzahn
values.description: You attempt to pierce a creature with flame- cloaked fangs. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is burned and flinches.

values.name: Feuerpeitsche
values.description: You strike out at a target in range with a burning lash,  Make a melee attack on a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage.  On a successful attack, the targeted creature must make a {save}.  On a fail, allies add +1 to any attack targeted at the creature for the duration.  This modifier can be stacked if it fails multiple Fire Lash saves, up to a maximum of +5.

values.name: Feuersäulen
values.description: You send a plume of flame towards a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After you land a hit, any ally that uses another Pledge move in the same round automatically hits.

values.name: Feuerschlag
values.description: You strike out with fire-infused fists. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is burned.

values.name: Feuerwirbel
values.description: You release a series of moving flames that dance around a target. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. as the flames swirl around it. As long as you maintain concentration, the target takes an additional 1d8 {type} damage at the end of each of its next three turns.

values.name: Überrumpler
values.description: You make quite the entrance, quickly attacking a creature. This attack can only be used on the first turn that the user has entered combat. Make a melee attack on a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Kiemenbiss
values.description: You rend the target with your hard gills. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target did not use an attacking move on its last turn, double the MOVE damage.

values.name: Geofissur
values.description: You crack open the ground with devastating force. Choose a target in range and roll a d20. On a 20, the target falls into the crack and vanished into the abyss. On any other roll, or if targeting a flying creature, this move has no effect. The area in a 20 foot radius around the target becomes difficult terrain. If the target's level is 10 more than your own, this move automatically fails.

values.name: Dreschflegel
values.description: You flail about with a wild strike that increases in power the more injured you are. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If you are below 50% of your maximum health, double the damage. If you are at 10% or below of your maximum health, triple the damage instead. The multiplier for this attack occurs before the multiplier for resistances or vulnerabilities.

values.name: Funkenflug
values.description: You release a fireball that explodes on contact. Choose a point in range. Any creature within 5 feet of that point must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a hit, or half as much on a success.

values.name: Nitroladung
values.description: You cloak yourself with flame and lash out at a creature. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. With each successful hit from this move, increase your movement speed by 5 until you are incapacitated, are switched out, or the combat ends. (Maximum of +30 to movement speed)

values.name: Flammenrad
values.description: A wheel of flame explodes out from you in a {shape}. All creatures in the area must succeed on a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail and half as much on a save. If the user is frozen, this move can still be used, thawing out the creature during the attack

values.name: Flammenwurf
values.description: You shoot a concentrated gout of flame in an {shape}. Any creature caught in the cone must succeed on a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half damage on a success. Any creature that fails the save by 5 or more becomes burned.

values.name: Flammenblitz
values.description: You cloak yourself in fire and charge at a creature with serious damage. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, you take a quarter of the damage dealt in typeless recoil damage. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is burned. If the user is frozen, this move can still be used, thawing out the creature during the attack

values.name: Blitz
values.description: You emit an immense flash of light in a {shape}, centered on you. Creatures in the area must make a {save}. On a fail, they are blinded until the end of their next turn. Outside of combat, this move can be used to light a dim area, much like the Light cantrip.

values.name: Lichtkanone
values.description: You gather energy from the light around you and send a concentrated beam towards a creature in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the next attack against the target is rolled at advantage.

values.name: Schmeichler
values.description: You send mixed signals to an creature in range. Force a target in range to make a {save}. On a fail, the target is confused, but it adds +2 to its attack rolls while confused.

values.name: Kanonenbouquet
values.description: You unleash a beam of energy in a {shape}, 5 feet wide.  All creatures in its path must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a hit, or half as much on a save.  After activating this move, your next attack is rolled at disadvantage. If the next attack requires a saving throw, the target(s) has advantage.

values.name: Schleuder
values.description: You sacrifice your held item to throw it a creature. Make a ranged attack. On a hit, the amount of dark damage dealt is equal to the price of the item in the manual, divided by 100 (rounded down), plus STAB (if applicable). In addition, certain items have additional effects on a successful hit with this move. After activating this move, on a hit or miss, the item disappears.

values.name: Rollwende
values.description: You switch places with an ally after making an attack. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After this move is activated, a trainer must switch out the user as a free action.

values.name: Florakur
values.description: You extend a healing energy to recover the hit points of a creature in range. The target gains {dice} hit points. If the terrain is grassy, double your MOVE modifier.

values.name: Floraschutz
values.description: Large flowers sprout from any grass-type allies in range, boosting their defense. For one minute, as long as you keep your concentration, grass-type allies within 15 feet of you gain +2 to their AC.

values.name: Flower Trick
values.description: You throw a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. The target makes a {save}. It takes {dice} {type} damage, half as much on successful save. This attack counts as landing a critical hit for the sake of other effects or triggers.

values.name: Fliegen
values.description: You fly high into the air to prepare for a dive bomb attack. When you activate this move, you use 10 feet of your movement to vanish and fly upwards, remaining in an invulnerable state until your next turn. During this time, you are immune to the damage and effects of any move. If you have no remaining movement or are grappled/restrained before activating this move, the move fails. On your next turn, you use your action to reappear and make a diving melee attack on a creature in range, with advantage, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a successful hit.

values.name: Flying Press
values.description: You dive at a creature with quick reaction speed, able to change the type of attack when you reach them. Make a melee attack against a target, dealing {dice} flying OR fighting damage, depending on your choice. STAB can only be added to this move if you are fighting type.

values.name: Fokusstoß
values.description: You heighten your focus and unleash it upon a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the next attack against the target is rolled at advantage.

values.name: Energiefokus
values.description: You shut your eyes and focus in on the energy inside you before striking. For the duration, increase your critical range by 2 (From 20 to 18+ , from 19+ to 17+, etc.). This move is not stackable.

values.name: Power-Punch
