values.description: When activating this move, you spend your action focusing your next attack. If you keep concentration, as an action on your next turn, make an attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Spotlight
values.description: You act quickly to entice an enemy to attack you. When a creature in range activates a Move that directly targets another creature, you may use your reaction to force the creature to make a {save}. On a fail, the Move must target you instead. If you are out of range of the Move, the creature must use their remaining movement to move in a straight line towards you before making the attack (does not provoke attacks of opportunity). If you are still out of range, the move automatically fails.

values.name: Kraftwelle
values.description:
You thrust your palm outward with such strength that a shockwave is sent towards a creature. Make a ranged or melee attack roll, depending on your target.

If used as a melee attack, deal {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 16 or higher, the target is paralyzed.

If used as a ranged attack, the range is 20 feet, and the damage is halved with no chance to paralyze.

values.name: Scharfblick
values.description: You grant yourself a brief but incredible sixth sense. On the next ghost-, normal-, or fighting-type move you activate, ignore any immunities of the target creature(s) granted by their Pokémon type. If the target’s secondary type gives it vulnerability or resistance to the attack, it follows the secondary type for that effect.

values.name: Waldesfluch
values.description: You summon the energy of the forest to change the type of another creature. Force a creature in range to make a {save}. On a failure, its type is changed to Grass through their next three turns in battle.

values.name: Schmarotzer
values.description: You turn a creature's own power against it. Make a melee attack roll using your MOVE power. On a hit, the target takes an amount of dark damage equal to {dice} + the target's level.

values.name: Frostvolt
values.description: When you use this move, you charge up a ball of rock-hard ice. On your next turn’s action, if you keep your concentration, you fire your electrically charged ice at a creature. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 15 or more, the target is paralyzed.

values.name: Gefriertrockner
values.description: You unleash a freezing cold air that rapidly chills a creature in range. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is frozen. This move deals super effective damage to water-type creatures. If the target’s secondary type is resistant to {type} damage, this move deals standard damage instead.

values.name: Eisiger Blick
values.description: You shoot psychic power from your eyes. Choose a creature in line of sight to make a {save}. On failure, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and becomes frozen. On success, they take half damage and is not frozen.

values.name: Flora-Statue
values.description: You summon a whirlwind of jagged branches and razor sharp leaves that batter all creatures in a {shape}, centered on you. All creatures caught in the flurry must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, and half as much on a success. This move saps you of energy, and may not activate it again until after the end of your next turn.

values.name: Eisesodem
values.description: You blow a gust of freezing cold air at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move scores a critical hit on natural attack rolls of 16 and higher.

values.name: Frustration
values.description: You lash out at a creature, venting your frustration at your trainer. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. When you make this attack, add an additional bonus to hit and damage equal to the number of levels you are below zero on the Loyalty Chart. This move bypasses the Loyalty penalty roll, except for uncontrollable creatures based on SR limitations.

values.name: Furienschlag
values.description: You reach out and unleash relentless strikes against a creature. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 {type} damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.

values.name: Zornklinge
values.description: You unleash series of cuts against a creature that increase in strength. When you activate this move, make a melee attack on a target in range, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If you use this move on your turn in consecutive rounds, double the dice roll for damage each time you hit. The multiplier maxes out at 8x the original damage. The damage resets if any of the attacks miss, or if you are incapacitated.

values.name: Kratzfurie
values.description: You reach out and unleash relentless claw attacks against a creature. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 {type} damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.

values.name: Kreuzdonner
values.description: You summon a gigantic lightning bolt that strikes down from the heavens in a 60 foot circle, centered on a point within range. All creatures caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If Fusion Flare was already used this round, double the damage dealt.

values.name: Kreuzflamme
values.description: You summon a gigantic fireball that strikes down from the heavens in a 60 foot circle, centered on a point within range. All creatures caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If Fusion Bolt was already used this round, double the damage dealt. Fusion Flare may be used to thaw out the user from the frozen status before attacking.

values.name: Seher
values.description: You save an attack to unleash at a later time. When you activate this move, you may choose to attack on this turn, or delay the attack. You may use the attack as a free action at any time during the next three rounds. When you make the attack, make a ranged attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Magensäfte
values.description: You hurl stomach acid towards a target. Make a ranged attack. On a hit, the target is covered in the disgusting substance and cannot benefit from the effect of any of its abilities for the duration.

values.name: Klikkdiskus
values.description: You send a pair of steel gears at a target(s) in range. Make two ranged attacks, dealing {dice} {type} damage with each hit.

values.name: Hilfsmechanik
values.description: You engage your gears to raise the attack of ally creatures in range with the Plus or Minus ability. While you maintain your concentration, Pokémon under the affects of Gear Up have advantage on all attack rolls.

values.name: Geokontrolle
values.description: You spend time to absorb the natural energy around you, sharply increasing your effect in battle. When you activate this move, your speed increases by 10 feet and all of your attacks and saving throws are rolled with advantage for three rounds.

values.name: Gigasauger
values.description: You attempt to drain the life force of a target. Make a ranged attack on a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Half of the damage dealt is restored to the user.

values.name: Gigastoß
values.description: You charge at a creature with every ounce of your power. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move cannot be used on consecutive turns by the same creature.

values.name: Gigaton Hammer
values.description: You swing your whole body around to attack with your huge hammer. Make a melee attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move cannot be used on consecutive turns by the same creature.

values.name: Blizzardlanze
values.description: You hurl a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. All other creatures within 5ft of the straight-line path between you and the target must make a {save}, taking 2×MOVE {type} damage on failure.

values.name: Eiszeit
values.description: You blow a wind of freezing cold air at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, reduce the target's speed by 5 feet. A target reduced to a speed of 0 in this manner becomes frozen. The target may use an action at any time (before becoming frozen) to warm its body, resetting its speed.

values.name: Glaive Rush
values.description: You throw your entire body into a reckless charge. Make a melee attack roll with advantage, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Until the start of your next turn, attack rolls made against you have advantage.

values.name: Schlangenblick
values.description: You stare into the depths of a creature’s eyes with intense ferocity. The creature must make a {save} or become frightened for the duration. A creature frightened in this way must make a {save} at the end of each of its turns to remove the effect.

values.name: Strauchler
values.description: You attempt to ensnare a creature with vines that sprout from the ground, causing it to trip. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the targets size is Large or bigger, double the dice roll for the damage. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target falls prone.

values.name: Pflanzensäulen
values.description: You send a column of thick grass towards a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After you land a hit, any ally that uses another Pledge move in the same round automatically hits.

values.name: Grasflöte
values.description: You make a shrill sound that has the chance to put a creature to sleep. The target must make a {save}, falling asleep on a failure.

values.name: Grasrutsche
values.description:
You glide on the ground to strike a target. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

If you are on Grassy Terrain when this move is used, then until the start of your next turn you gain an additional 10ft of movement, and your movement no longer provokes attacks of opportunity.

values.name: Grasfeld
values.description: Grass sprouts from the ground in a circle around you, coating the earth with healing energy. For 3 turns, grounded creatures in the affected area heal for an amount of hit points equal to their proficiency bonus at the end of their turn. Grounded creatures are those that do not have a flying speed or Levitate, Magnet Rise, or similar ability. In addition, creatures may double their MOVE modifier on damage rolls from grass-type moves activated inside the area.

values.name: Gravitation
values.description:
You summon an apple which accosts its victim's head. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on hit. On a hit, the target must make a {save}, suffering -1 to AC on failure until the end of the encounter or until the target is withdrawn. This effect may stack up to three times.

If enhanced gravity is in effect, such as via the move Gravity, double the damage dice for this move.

values.name: Erdanziehung
values.description: You strengthen gravity in an {shape}, centered on you. Any creature in the area cannot use moves like Fly or Bounce, flying types lose their ground immunity, and the Levitate ability is suppressed.

values.name: Heuler
values.description: You target a creature with an intimidating growl. The creature must make a {save}. On a fail, it adds -1 to any attack it makes for the duration. This modifier can be stacked if it fails multiple growl saves, up to a maximum of -5.

values.name: Wachstum
values.description: You increase the size of a target. When you use this move, a creature in range (or you) grows slightly larger, gaining the ability to add a d4 to any attack roll or saving throw for the duration.
values.higherLevels: The dice to add increases to 1d6 at level 10.

values.name: Nachspiel
values.description: The moment you would take damage from a move that reduces you to zero hit points, you may use your reaction to force the attacker to make a {save}. On a failure, all PP from the move that caused you to faint is depleted.

values.name: Schutzteiler
values.description: You use your psychic power to change your defense to match the target's the best you can. Force a creature in range to make a {save}. On a failure, for the duration, your AC changes to become an average of your current AC and the target's, rounded down.

values.name: Schutztausch
values.description: You use your psychic power to swap defenses with a creature. Force a creature in range to make a {save}. On a failure, switch armor class with the target for the duration.

values.name: Guillotine
values.description: You are filled with an incredible rage, grabbing the head of a target creature in an attempt to squeeze the life from it. Roll a d20. On a 20, you instantly cause the creature to faint. On any other roll, this move has no effect. If the target's level is 10 more than your own, this move automatically fails.

values.name: Mülltreffer
values.description: You fire a wad of icky gunk at a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 16 or higher, the target is poisoned.

values.name: Windstoß
values.description: You create a strong wind that batters a target in range. Make a ranged attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Gyroball
values.description: You tackle a creature with a high-speed spin. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If your DEX score is lower than the target's, double the dice roll for damage.

values.name: Hagelsturm
values.description: You stir up a massive hail storm in a 50 foot radius, centered on a point in range. When a non ice-type creature enters the area for the first time on their turn, or begins their turn inside the area, they take an amount of ice damage equal to half your level, rounded up. The hail storm lasts for 5 rounds.

values.name: Halo Song
values.description: A captivating song fills the air around you. When an enemy creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a {save}. On a failed save, the creature takes {dice} {type} damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

values.name: Hammerarm
values.description: You put all your power into a strong and heavy fist attack. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Until the beginning of your next turn, you have disadvantage on all DEX saves and your speed is halved.

values.name: Goldene Zeiten
values.description: You celebrate your impending victory with a little jig. Prize money awarded at the end of battle is doubled.

values.name: Stahlpresse
values.description: You crush a creature with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. Make a melee attack against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage. If the target is above 50% of its maximum health, add your proficiency bonus to the damage roll.

values.name: Härtner
values.description: You increase your defense, able to reduce incoming damage. After activating this move, reduce any damage dealt to you by {dice} until the beginning of your next turn.

values.name: Dunkelnebel
values.description: You create a haze of light snow that washes over creatures in a {shape}, centered on you. Any stat changes, status effects, shields or other outside forces affecting creatures in range are removed. This includes things like Leech Seed, Focus Energy, Substitute, Iron Defense, Disable, etc.

values.name: Steinschädel
values.description: You lower your head and charge at a creature. Make a melee attack. On a hit, you deal {dice} {type} damage, taking a quarter of the total damage (rounded down) in typeless recoil.

values.name: Kopfstoß
values.description: You lower your head to deliver a dangerous headbutt. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the user takes 1/2 the damage dealt in typeless recoil.

values.name: Kopfnuss
values.description: You really know how to use your head. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target falls prone.

values.name: Headlong Rush
values.description: You smash into a target with a full-body tackle, sacrificing your defenses. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After activating this move, the target has advantage on any attack it makes against you before the beginning of your next turn.

values.name: Vitalglocke
values.description: You ring a bell that chimes beautifully across the battlefield. All active allied creatures within 60 feet of you are healed of their negative status effects.

values.name: Heilblockade
values.description: When a creature within range attempts to use an HP recovery move, item, or ability, you may use your reaction to send psychic waves into the mind of the target, preventing the recovery of health.

values.name: Heilbefehl
values.description: You summon forth your underlings to heal your wounds. Regain {dice} hit points.

values.name: Heilwoge
values.description: You emit a healing pulse that restores a target's HP. Choose a target in range (cannot be yourself). The target regains {dice} hit points.

values.name: Heilopfer
values.description: You sacrifice yourself for another one of your trainer's Pokémon. When activating this move, the user faints, but the next conscious creature released by its trainer is healed of all status effects and recovers an amount of HP equal to what the user lost by fainting.

values.name: Herzstempel
values.description: You unleash a vicious blow after acting cute. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Statustausch
values.description: Force a creature in range to make a {save}. On a failure, you employ your psychic power to swap any changes in ability modifiers, AC, attack changes, damage boosts, etc. that are currently in affect on you or the target.

values.name: Brandstempel
values.description: You slam into a creature with your flaming body. Make a melee attack on a target, dealing a minimum of {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Add an additional bonus to damage equal to your MOVE modifier for each size level you are above a creature. (Sizes, in order, are: Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, Huge, Gargantuan)

values.name: Hitzewelle
values.description: You exhale a wave of hot breath in a {shape}, centered on you. Creatures caught in the area must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on failure, or half as much on a success. If the creature fails the save by 5 or more, it is burned.

values.name: Rammboss
values.description: You slam into a creature with your heavy body. Make a melee attack on a target, dealing a minimum of {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Add an additional bonus to damage equal to your MOVE modifier for each size level you are above a creature. (Sizes, in order, are: Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, Huge, Gargantuan)

values.name: Rechte Hand
values.description: You can use a bonus action on your turn to choose one ally other than yourself within 60 feet of you who can hear you. That ally can add a d6 to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes within the next 10 minutes, before the result of the roll is called by the DM. An ally being helped can only have one d6 available at a time.
values.higherLevels: The helping dice for this move changes to d8 at level 5, d10 at level 10, and d12 at level 17.

values.name: Bürde
values.description: You send a ghostly energy at a creature that does additional damage to those affected by status conditions. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target is affected by a status condition, double your MOVE modifier when adding damage.

values.name: Kraftreserve
values.description: You unleash a wave of force of unknown power at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack on a creature, on a hit doing {dice} damage of a random type. Roll a d20 to determine which type of damage is dealt.

values.name: Pferdestärke
values.description: You fiercely attack the target using your entire body.  Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Turmkick
values.description: You leap into the air to deliver a strong kick to a target. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a miss, you take 1 damage.

values.name: Zurückhaltung
values.description: You lash out with force, but contain your strike to a glancing blow, leaving a creature conscious. Make a melee attack on a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This attack will always leave its target with 1 hp if it would otherwise cause the target to faint.

values.name: Händchenhalten
values.description: If you are within melee range of an ally, you grasp its hand to spread happiness. Use this reaction when an ally is attacking to add +1 to its attack rolls, or when it is targeted by an attack to add +1 to its AC. This reaction can be used only before the result of either attack roll (by ally or creature) is called.

values.name: Klauenwetzer
values.description: You sharpen your claws to increase the power of your attacks. For the duration, add an additional +1 to your attack and damage rolls. This move may be stacked to a maximum of +3 to attack and damage rolls.

values.name: Jauler
values.description: You pierce the air with an intimidating howl. Until the end of your next turn, allies (and you) have advantage on any melee attack rolls they make against a creature within 5 feet of you.

values.name: Hornattacke
values.description: You strike at a target with your horn. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If you moved 20 feet or more straight towards the target immediately before activating this move, force it to make a {save} or be knocked prone.

values.name: Hornbohrer
values.description: You attempt to drill your horn through a target creature with tremendous strength. Roll a d20. On a 20, the creature is impaled and immediately faints. On any other roll, you miss and this move fails. If the target's level is 10 more than your own, this move automatically fails.

values.name: Holzgeweih
values.description: You sink your horns into a creature, draining some of their power. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Half the damage dealt is recovered by the user (rounded down).

values.name: Orkan
values.description: You whip up a maelstrom of harsh winds. Each creature in a 30 ft radius, centered on a point within range, must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage and knocked prone on a failure, or half as much damage without being knocked prone on a success. Targets that fail the saving throw by 5 or more become confused. If this attack is activated during rain, the targets roll their saving throws with disadvantage. If used during harsh sunlight, the targets roll their saves with advantage.

values.name: Aquahaubitze
values.description: You fire a powerful stream of high-speed water at creatures in a {shape}, 5 feet wide. Any creature caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, and half as much on a success. Creatures that fail the save also are pushed back 10 feet and fall prone. This move saps you of energy, and may not activate it again until after the end of your next turn.

values.name: Hydropumpe
values.description: You send a surge of powerful water towards creatures in a {shape}, 5 feet wide. Creatures caught in the blast must succeed on a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failed save, and half as much on a success.

values.name: Hydrodampf
values.description: You blast the target with boiling-hot water. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move's damage is not subject to disadvantage in Harsh Sunlight. If you are in Harsh Sunlight, you make the attack with advantage.

values.name: Hyperstrahl
values.description: You unleash a concentrated beam of pure energy in a {shape}, 5ft wide. Any creature caught in the line must succeed on a {save} or take {dice} {type} damage on a fail and half as much on a save. This move cannot be used on consecutive turns by the same creature.

values.name: Hyper Drill
values.description: You crash into a creature, spinning your body like a drill. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This attack pierces through defensive moves such as Protect or Detect and ignores AC bonuses from spells such as Shield.

values.name: Hyperzahn
values.description: You lash out at a creature with a quick fang attack. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Hyper Fang scores a critical hit on 19 and 20. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target flinches.

values.name: Schallwelle
values.description: You release a loud and startling, high-pitched sound that only a creature can hear. Make a ranged attack roll against a creature in range, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Dimensionswahn
values.description: Using your many arms, you send a barrage of three balls of furious energy at any creature(s) in range. Each ball automatically deals {dice} {type} damage to any creature(s) you choose. Reactions that negate damage such as Protect or Detect cannot be used. After activating this move, any attacks against you, until the beginning of your next turn, are rolled at advantage.
values.higherLevels: You can fire 4 projectiles at level 5, 5 projectiles at level 10, and 6 projectiles at level 17.

values.name: Dimensionsloch
values.description: You create a hyperspace portal that allows you to instantly teleport to a creature in range and strike out with a melee attack. This move is guaranteed to hit for {dice} {type} damage. Reactions that negate damage such as Protect or Detect cannot be used.

values.name: Hypnose
values.description: You attempt to put the target to sleep. The target must make a {save}, falling asleep on a failure.

values.name: Frostbeule
values.description: You roll into a rock-hard ball of ice and continue to pummel a creature. When you activate this move, make a melee attack on a target in range, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If you use this move on your turn in consecutive rounds, double the dice roll for damage each time you hit. The multiplier maxes out at 8x the original damage. The damage resets if any of the attacks miss, or if you are incapacitated.

values.name: Eisstrahl
values.description: You create a {shape} of freezing ice, 5 feet wide. Any creature caught in the line must succeed on a {save} or take {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Creatures that fail this save by 5 or more become frozen.

values.name: Frosthauch
values.description: When you use this move, you charge up an intense power within your body. On your next turn’s action, if you keep your concentration, you unleash an ultracold, freezing wind in a {shape} all around you. Anyone caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If any creature fails the save by 5 or more, it is burned.

values.name: Eiszahn
values.description: You attempt to pierce a creature with ice- infused fangs. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is frozen and flinches.

values.name: Eishammer
values.description: You swing and hit with your strong, heavy fist.  Make a melee attack dealing {dice} {type} damage.  Until the beginning of your next turn, you have disadvantage on all DEX saves and your speed is halved.

values.name: Eishieb
values.description: You strike out with ice-infused fists. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is frozen.

values.name: Eissplitter
values.description: You flash freeze chunks of ice and quickly hurl them at a creature. As a bonus action, you fire a shard of ice at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Ice Spinner
values.description: You cover your feet in thin ice and twirl around. All creatures within melee range must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Additionally, any active terrain you are in is removed.

values.name: Eiszapfhagel
values.description: You generate a row of icicles that crash down on top of a creature in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 15 or higher, the target flinches.

values.name: Eisspeer
values.description: Your pummel a creature in range with multiple sharp shards of ice. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 {type} damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.

values.name: Eissturm
values.description: You create an icy wind that gusts towards a creature in range. Make a ranged attack against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 18 or more, the target falls prone.

values.name: Begrenzer
values.description: You create psychic walls within the mind of a target in range. Force the target to make a {save}. On a failure, the target is unable to use any Move it knows that is the same as yours for the duration.

values.name: Einäschern
values.description: You summon forth a burning hot flame that surrounds a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, if the target is holding a berry, it is immediately burned to ash, becoming unusable.

values.name: Infernal Parade
values.description: You launch a myriad of fireballs. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target is affected by a status condition, double your MOVE modifier when adding damage. On a hit, the target must make a {save}, becoming burned on failure.

values.name: Inferno
values.description: You engulf a target in intense flames. Make a ranged attack against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit, burning the target in the process.

values.name: Plage
values.description: You summon an infestation of tiny insects to attack a creature for multiple turns. Make a ranged attack on a target. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and becomes infested with swarming bugs. As long as you maintain concentration, the target takes an additional 1d8 {type} damage at the end of each of its next three turns.

values.name: Verwurzler
values.description: You pierce the ground with roots, absorbing natural energy and fixing you in place. At the end of each of your next three turns (including this one), heal yourself for {dice} hit points. For the duration of this move, your movement speed drops to zero and you may not flee or be switched out by your trainer unless forced by an opponent's moves or abilities.

values.name: Kommando
values.description: You instruct a creature to act again. As an action, choose a target in range. The target must immediately repeat the move they used in their last action or bonus action, without spending the PP.

values.name: Plasmaschauer
values.description: You disperse electric particles that charge the battlefield. Until the beginning of your next turn, any normal-type move activated within 50 feet of you is considered electric-type.

values.name: Eisenabwehr
values.description: Your body temporarily becomes solid as steel plate. Until the end of your next turn, you gain + 6 to your AC and have resistance to all types of damage. If you were vulnerable, you now take regular damage. If you were already resistant, you become immune.

values.name: Eisenschädel
values.description: You slam into the target with your hard head. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 16 or higher, the target flinches.

values.name: Eisenschweif
values.description: You swing your tail out, attempting to crush a creature. Make an attack roll on a creature in range, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is a 19 or 20, the target’s AC is decreased by 1 for the rest of combat.

values.name: Ivy Cudgel
values.description: You strike with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Ivy Cudgel scores a critical hit on 19s and 20s. When used by Ogerpon, the type of this attack and damage changes to that of the mask it is wearing:

values.name: Fesselbiss
values.description:
You latch onto a foe, never to let go. Make a melee attack against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

On a hit, you grapple the target. On your turn, you may activate this move against a target grappled this way to deal {dice} {type} damage. This move can grapple targets up to two sizes larger than you.

values.name: Jet Punch
values.description: You summon a torrent around your fist and punch with blinding speed. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Urteilskraft
values.description: You send powerful missiles of pure energy to rain down on any creature in an 80 foot circle, centered on a point in range. Any creature caught in the area must make a {save}, taking {dice} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. The type of the damage depends on the kind of plate the user is holding.

values.name: Sprungkick
values.description: You leap into the air to deliver a strong kick to a creature. Make a melee attack against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a miss, you take 1 damage.

values.name: Dschungelheilung
values.description: You become one with the jungle. You and all allies withing 15 ft of you regain {dice} hit points and are cured of any negative status conditions.

values.name: Karateschlag
values.description: You extend a hand towards a target creature for a savage karate chop. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Karate Chop scores a critical hit on 19s and 20s.

values.name: Psykraft
values.description: You move with incredible speed. Increase your walking, flying, or swimming speed by 20 if it is greater than 0, and add +2 to AC when targeted by ranged attacks for the duration. This move cannot be stacked.

values.name: Königsschild
values.description: Your body is cloaked with a protective shield that negates all damage to you. When targeted by an attack, you may automatically avoid taking damage from this attack and any other damaging move until the beginning of your next turn. On future instances of this move in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful.

values.name: Abschlag
values.description: You attempt to rid a creature of their held item for the rest of battle. Make a melee attack roll against a target. On a hit, deal {dice} {type} damage and any held item of the target disappears. The item appears back in the target's inventory when the battle is over.

values.name: Kowtow Cleave
values.description: You slash your opponent after kowtowing so they let down their guard. The target must make a {save}. On failure, the target takes {dice} {type} damage, or half that damage on a successful save.

values.name: Bodengewalt
values.description: You gather in the natural energy of the land around you and focus it into a sudden eruption of earth in a 40 ft radius, centered on a point within range. All creatures caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

values.name: Konzentration
values.description: When activating this move, you spend your action concentrating intensely. If you keep your concentration, your first attack roll on your next turn always results in a Critical Hit.

values.name: Frustventil
values.description:
You lash out to vent your frustration toward the target. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

If you are suffering from a non-volatile status condition, or any of your AC, STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, or CHA is currently lowered, then you make the attack with advantage and deal an additional MOVE {type} damage.

values.name: Zuflucht
values.description: You lash out an a creature with a furious strike. This move can only be activated when all other known moves by a user have been activated in the same combat. If the user is switched out, this rule resets. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Last Respects
values.description: You avenge your allies with a powerful attack. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Increase the damage dice by 2d6 for each of your currently downed allies this combat, up to a maximum of 10d6.

values.name: Flammensturm
values.description: You summon forth a plume of raging hot fire in a 5 foot radius, 40-foot cylinder, centered on a point within range. Creatures in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure and becoming burned, or half as much without becoming burned on a success.

values.name: Laubklinge
values.description: You attempt to slash a creature with a sharp leaf. Make a melee attack against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This attack scores a critical on 19 and 20.

values.name: Blättersturm
values.description: You whip up a powerful storm of leaves in a 40 foot circle, centered on a point within range. All creatures in the area must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, or half as much on a success. After activating this move, you are sapped of energy. On any damaging move you activate before the end of your next turn, reduce the damage dealt by your MOVE modifier.

values.name: Grasmixer
values.description: You summon forth a cyclone of harsh winds and fast moving leaves that rushes forward to strike a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 15 or higher, the target has disadvantage on its next attack. If the target activates a move that requires a saving throw, its target(s) have advantage on the roll.

values.name: Blattwerk
values.description: You summon a flurry of leaves to pelt a target. Make a ranged attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Blutsauger
values.description: You attempt to suck away some of a creature’s life force. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Half of the damage done is restored to the user.

values.name: Egelsamen
values.description: You send a seed at a creature in range that implants itself in their hide. Make a ranged attack roll. On a hit, a seed implants into their skin. The target takes {dice} {type} damage at the end of each of its subsequent turns until it faints, is switched out, or combat ends. Half of the damage is restored by the attacker, or any other active creature the trainer has in battle, even if the original attacker faints or is returned to its Pokéball. Only one creature can be seeded by the attacker at a time. Grass-type creatures are immune to the damage from this move.

values.name: Silberblick
values.description: You stare down a target, reducing its will. The creature must make a {save}. On a fail, allies may add +1 to any attack they target it with for the duration. This modifier can be stacked if it fails multiple leer saves, up to a maximum of +5.

values.name: Schlecker
values.description: You reach out and lick a target. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, do {dice} {type} damage. On a natural attack roll of 18 or higher, the target becomes paralyzed.

values.name: Lebenstropfen
values.description: You scatter mysterious water around yourself. You and all allies withing 15 ft of you regain {dice} hit points.

values.name: Lux Calamitatis
values.description: You draw forth a powerful natural essence, concentrating it into a beam of light 80ft long and 5 feet wide. Any creature caught in the blast must make {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. The user takes typeless recoil damage equal to half the damage roll.

values.name: Lichtschild
values.description: When you are subject to a ranged attack, use your reaction to take half the damage dealt now and on any ranged attack that targets you until the beginning of your next turn.

values.name: Aquadurchstoß
values.description: You attempt to slam a full-force blast of water into a target in range.  Make a ranged attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.  If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target’s AC is reduced by 1 while it remains in battle. This decrease may be stacked up to a maximum of -5 to AC.

values.name: Zielschuss
values.description: You hone in on your target, ready to strike. When this move is activated, a single attack roll you make next turn is guaranteed to hit. You may roll to see if you crit or cause an effect from a high roll. This move does not affect one-shot moves like Fissure, Guillotine, etc.

values.name: Todeskuss
values.description: You blow a kiss to a creature, attempting to put the target to sleep. The target must make a {save}, falling asleep on a failure.

values.name: Fußkick
values.description: You kick out at a creature’s lower half, dealing damage and attempting to knock it off balance. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 19 or 20, the target flinches.

values.name: Fußtritt
values.description: You sweep your legs at the lower half of a creature's body. Make a melee attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, target must succeed on a {save} or be knocked prone.

values.name: Beschwörung
values.description: When a creature scores a critical hit on you or an ally in range, you may use your reaction to quickly recite a magical incantation that treats the attack like a normal hit, preventing the extra damage and/or effect of the crit.

values.name: Lumina Crash
values.description: You unleash a peculiar light that affects the mind. Each creature in range must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure or half that damage on a success. Each creature that fails also has -2 to their {save}s until the end of your next turn.

values.name: Lunar Blessing
values.description: You bless the surrounding area with the light of a crescent moon. For the duration, when an allied creature (including yourself) starts its turn within 100 feet of you, they regain {dice} hit points and are cured of any negative Status Conditions.

values.name: Lunartanz
values.description: You sacrifice yourself for another one of your trainer's Pokémon. When activating this move, the user faints, but the next creature released by its trainer is fully healed and cured of any status effects.

values.name: Anfallen
values.description: You make a lunge at the target, attacking with full force.  Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.  If the natural attack roll is 15 or more, the target has disadvantage on its next attack.

values.name: Scheinwerfer
values.description: You create a blinding bright light that damages creature's eyes and may lower their defense. Creatures in range must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. For creatures that fail by 5 or more, any attack against them has advantage until the end of your next turn.

values.name: Tempohieb
values.description: You rush forward to punch with incredible speed. Choose a target within 10 feet of you. You rush forward to slam a fist into the creature, avoiding all attacks of opportunity. Make a melee attack on that creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Magiemantel
values.description: A flash of magical energy forms between you and a creature, reflecting negative energy back at an attacker in range. When an attack from a creature causes you to suffer from a negative status condition, they are also affected by the same condition.

values.name: Magiepuder
values.description: You scatter a cloud of magic powder at a foe. Target creature within 30 ft must make a {save}. On failure, their type changes to Psychic type for the duration.

values.name: Magieraum
values.description: You employ your psychic power to suppress the effect of all held items within 50 feet of you

values.name: Zauberblatt
values.description: You summon a sharp, magical leaf that strikes a creature. This move is guaranteed to hit for {dice} {type} damage, unless during the invulnerable stage of Fly, Dig, Bounce, Dive, etc. moves.
values.optional: The Shield spell blocks all damage from this attack.

values.name: Lavasturm
values.description: You stir up a maelstrom of fire in a 40 foot circle, centered on a point within range, that continues to rage as long as you hold your concentration. Any creature that enters this area for the first time on their turn, or is in that area at the beginning of their turn must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

values.name: Magnetbombe
values.description: You hurl a steel ball that seeks out a creature in range, never missing. This move is guaranteed to hit for {dice} {type} damage, unless during the invulnerable stage of Fly, Dig, Bounce, Dive, etc. moves.

values.name: Magnetflug
values.description: You use magnetic power within yourself to raise yourself from the ground, becoming immune to ground moves for the duration.

values.name: Magnetregler
values.description: You use your electric energy to manipulate magnetic fields. Until the beginning of your next turn, any creature in range with the Plus or Minus ability gains a bonus to their AC equal to your proficiency modifier, and any saving throw they are forced to make is rolled with advantage.

values.name: Intensität
values.description: You shake the ground with an earth-shattering quake. All creatures in range must make a {save}, taking half damage on a success and full damage on a fail. Creatures in range that are burrowed or in the invulnerable stage of Dig take double damage from this move. Roll a d100 on the table below to determine damage. Raised creatures are immune to the effects and damage of this move.
values.higherLevels: For damage rolls, use 2× Dice at level 5, 3× Dice at level 10, and 4× Dice at level 17.

values.name: Make it Rain
values.description: You throw out a mass of coins. Each creature in range must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on failure, half on success. You gain 1d10 ₽ for each creature that fails the save, and 2d10 ₽ for each creature that succeeds.

values.name: Giftkettung
values.description: You pour toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. A creature that is hit must make a {save} or be badly poisoned.

values.name: Tatami-Schild
values.description: You conjure up a ethereal, protective mat to shield you and your allies. Until the end of your next turn, any ally creature within 15 feet of you (including you) is immune to damage from damaging moves. Status-inducing moves can still affect their targets.

values.name: Matcha Gotcha
values.description: You spray a blast of tea that you mixed. Creatures in range must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on failure, half on success. For each creature that failed the save, you regain 1d6 HP.

values.name: Egotrip
values.description: When targeted by or forced to make a saving throw from a single-target move, you may use your reaction to copy the creature’s move against it, after activation but before the effects. If the move requires an attack roll, you have disadvantage on the attack. If the move requires a saving throw, the target has advantage on the roll. If the move causes damage, double the damage dice. The damage/effect tier for the move is based off of your level, not the target's.

values.name: Horrorblick
values.description: You flash an intimidating look at a target, attempting to freeze them in fear. Force a target in range to make a {save}. On a fail, the target cannot flee or be switched out for 3 rounds.

values.name: Meditation
values.description: You become one with your inner self. For the duration, you gain +1 to attack rolls and saving throws.
values.higherLevels: The bonus changes to +2 at level 5, +3 at level 10, and +4 at level 17.

values.name: Megasauger
values.description: You attempt to drain the life force of a target. Make a ranged attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Half of the damage dealt is restored to the user.

values.name: Megakick
values.description: Make a melee attack against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Megahieb
values.description: You strike out with a hard punch Make a melee attack against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Vielender
values.description: You charge at a creature for a devastating horn attack. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If you moved 20 feet or more straight towards the target immediately before activating this move, force it to make a {save} or be knocked prone.

values.name: Memento-Mori
values.description: You sacrifice your life force to leave a lasting mark on a target. When you activate this move, you touch a creature and drop to 0 hit points. As a result, the target is incapacitated for 2 rounds. All attacks against it have advantage, it automatically fails all STR and DEX saving throws by the maximum amount, and it cannot attack, move, flee, or be switched out.

values.name: Metallstoß
values.description: You lash out in retaliation with a bust of harsh metal shards. As a reaction, when you are hit with a melee attack that deals damage, make a melee attack roll against your attacker, with disadvantage. On a hit, deal the same amount of steel type damage back at your attacker (maximum of 5x your current level).

values.name: Metallklaue
values.description: You strike out with sharp claws. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 19 or 20, your next attack gets an additional +1 to hit.

values.name: Metallsound
values.description: You emit an ear-shattering high pitched sound that only your target can hear, leaving them in a defenseless state. When activating this move, a target must make a {save}. On a failure, all attack rolls against the target are given a +5 bonus until the end of your next turn.

values.name: Sternensturm
values.description: The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move cannot be used on consecutive turns by the same creature.

values.name: Meteorstrahl
values.description: When you use this move, soak in cosmic energy and prepare to unleash a devastating beam. On your next turn, if you keep your concentration, use an action to create a {shape} of solar energy, 5 feet wide. Any creature caught in the line must succeed on a {save} or take {dice} {type} damage on a fail and half as much on a save.

values.name: Sternenhieb
values.description: You smash a creature with a fist as fast as a meteor strike. Make a melee attack against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or higher, your next attack has advantage.

values.name: Metronom
values.description: You summon a move at random to inflict against a creature. When you use this move, roll a d100. The resulting number is the TM number for the move you make. If the move is unable to be completed because of positioning, range, etc., Metronome fails.
values.optional:
Instead of a d100, roll a d256.

If using real dice, roll a d4 and two d10s; for the d4, treat a result of "4" as "0" instead. The d4 result represents the hundred's place, the first d10 represents the ten's place, and the second d10 represents the one's place. This combined number is the TM number for Metronome. If no such TM exists, reroll all three dice until it does.

values.name: Wuchtklinge
values.description: You wield the light that has accumulated atop your head to cleave the target. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move hits and deals damage even through moves/abilities that would negate it, such as Protect, Spiky Shield, etc.

values.name: Milchgetränk
values.description: You create a tasty drink that heals your or an ally’s wounds. The recipient gains {dice} hit points.

values.name: Mimikry
values.description: You copy another creature's movements, learning its ways in battle. When used, this move is temporarily replaced by your choice of one of the target's moves. The target can be an ally. After one PP is subtracted to use this move, the replacement move will retain Mimic's remaining PP. The user can select any of the target's moves to copy for the duration.
values.optional:
This move may also copy a DnD spell. The pokemon's level determines the maximum spell level that can be copied. This cannot copy a spell that requires concentration.

| Pokemon Level | Spell Level |
| --- | --- |
| 1-4 | 2 |
| 5-9 | 3 |
| 10-16 | 4 |
| 17-20 | 5 |

values.name: Knallkopf
values.description: You fill your head with hot fire that explodes around you. Force all creatures within 15 feet of you to make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. After activating this move, you take an amount of typless damage equal to the full damage as if you failed the save.

values.name: Willensleser
values.description: You sense the motives and moves of a creature around you. When this move is activated, a single attack roll you make next turn is guaranteed to hit. You may roll to see if you crit or cause an effect from a high roll. This move does not affect one-shot moves like Fissure, Guillotine, etc.

values.name: Komprimator
values.description: You appear smaller to your creatures, increasing your evasion. For the duration, you gain an additional +2 to your AC.

values.name: Wunderauge
values.description: You flash your eyes at the target, stunning them briefly and lowering their defenses. When activating this move, choose a target in range and force them to make a {save}. On a failure, any modifiers to their AC are reset, and if they are Dark or Ghost-type, their immunities are relinquished for the duration. If, when losing immunity, the target’s secondary type gives it vulnerability or resistance to an attack of that type, it follows the secondary type for that effect.

values.name: Spiegelcape
values.description: When subject to a ranged attack, you can attempt to decrease the damage and send some back at the attacker in range. Using this reaction, the damage is decreased by {dice}. If this causes the damage to fall below zero, the attack is deflected and you may make a ranged attack roll to send it back at the attacker for {dice} {type} damage.

values.name: Spiegeltrick
values.description: You mimic a target that you can see, in range. When you activate this move, choose a target in range and fully execute the most recent move used by the creature, using your own ability scores, level, and typing for saving throw DC, attack, and damage.

values.name: Spiegelsalve
values.description: You loose a damaging flash of light from your polished body. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the target must make a {save}. On a failure, the target has disadvantage on its next attack roll.

values.name: Weißnebel
values.description: A light mist surrounds a target, offering a protective barrier. The target is immune to negative stat changes for the duration, but any current effects are still in place.

values.name: Nebelball
values.description: You fire an explosive ball of damaging mist at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 11 or higher, the target has disadvantage on any attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

values.name: Nebelexplosion
values.description: You release a massive explosion in a {shape}, fainting immediately before the damage is dealt. Creatures in the area must make a {save}. If your creature has at least half its hit points left or this move was used on Misty Terrain, anyone in range takes {dice} {type} damage on a fail, or half as much on a success. If your creature has less than half of its hit points left and was not on Misty Terrain, the damage is halved for a failed save, and quartered for a success.

values.name: Nebelfeld
values.description: You cover the ground in a thin, healing mist that surrounds a {shape}, centered on you. For 3 turns, no grounded creatures inside the mist can suffer from new status conditions. Grounded creatures are those that do not have a flying speed or Levitate, Magnet Rise, or similar ability. In addition, grounded creatures in the terrain are resistant to dragon-type damage, or if they were vulnerable to dragon-type damage, they take regular damage instead.

values.name: Mondgewalt
values.description: You summon forth a powerful moonbeam that strikes a creature. Make a ranged attack on a target in range, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 15 or more, the target has disadvantage on its next attack.

values.name: Schattenstrahl
values.description: You emit a sinister ray that explodes out from you in a {shape}, 5 feet wide. All creatures caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure or half as much on a success. This attack ignores any of the creatures abilities that would affect the user's ability to hit or deal full damage.

values.name: Mondschein
values.description: A ray of moonlight shines upon you, basking you in healing light. The user gains {dice} hit points. If this move is activated during the day, halve the total healing.

values.name: Morgengrauen
values.description: A ray of sunlight shines upon you, basking you in healing light. The user gains {dice} hit points. If this move is activated at night, halve the total healing.

values.name: Mortal Spin
values.description:
You strike out with an incredibly fast spinning move. All creatures within melee range must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Creatures that fail the save are also poisoned.

In addition, this move automatically frees the user from Leech Seed or anything causing it to be grappled or restrained. It is removed from these statuses before the saving throw is made.

values.name: Mountain Gale
values.description: You hurl giant chunks of ice at the target. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the target must succeed a {save} or flinch.

values.name: Schlammbombe
values.description: You throw a hard-packed mud ball at a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the target must make a {save}. On a failure, the target has disadvantage on its next attack roll. If activating a move that requires a save, the target(s) have advantage.

values.name: Lehmschuss
values.description: You fire a glob of mud at a creature, dealing damage with a chance to hinder the target's movement. Make a ranged attack against a creature in range, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 16 or higher, the target's speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.

values.name: Lehmsuhler
values.description: You cover yourself and all allies around you with thick mud, reducing the amount of electric damage taken for anyone affected. For the duration, you and any ally in range (when you initially activated this move) have resistance to electric-type attacks. If an affected creature was already resistant, it is now immune. If it was vulnerable, it now takes normal damage. If it was immune to electric-type moves already, nothing happens.

values.name: Lehmschelle
values.description: You hurl mud at a target in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the target adds -1 to its attack rolls for the rest of the encounter. This decrease may be stacked, up to a maximum of -5 to hit. The target may take an action to remove any mud from its face, resetting the effect.

values.name: Lehmbrühe
values.description: You fire a stream of muddy water at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage. If the natural attack roll is 15 or higher, the target has disadvantage on its next attack.

values.name: Multi-Angriff
values.description: You strike out with inner power, depending on your type. Make a melee attack on a target, dealing {dice} damage of your current type.

values.name: Magieflamme
values.description: You summon forth a pair of mystical flames that dance around a target, dealing damage. Make a ranged attack roll against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target is hit with this attack, any attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn is rolled at disadvantage.

values.name: Mystical Power
values.description: You attack by emitting mystical power. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the attack hit, you gain +1 to all attack rolls made with INT, WIS, or CHA as the Move Power until the end of the encounter or until switched out. If the attack missed, you gain +1 AC until the end of the encounter or until switched out. The sum of these bonuses cap at +5 total.

values.name: Ränkeschmied
values.description: You stimulate your brain with nasty thoughts. For the duration, you have advantage on any attacks with the Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma move power. If the attack requires a Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma saving throw, the target has disadvantage.

values.name: Beerenkräfte
values.description: You draw in power from your held berry, releasing it into a ranged attack. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} damage on a hit. The type is dependant on what berry you are holding, according to the chart below:

values.name: Natur-Kraft
values.description: You call upon the powers of nature nearby and activate a move based on the environment. The DM gets final say on what move you activate, but here are example environment types:

values.name: Naturzorn
values.description: You harness all the power of nature and send it at a creature in range. The target must make a {save}. On a failed save, the target loses half their current HP (minimum of 1 damage).

values.name: Nietenranke
values.description: Your arms turn to jagged, thorny needles as you strike a creature. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is a 15 or more, the target flinches.

values.name: Nachtflut
values.description: A pitch black shockwave of dark energy rushes towards a target. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 13 or more, the target rolls its next attack with disadvantage. If it activates a move that requires a saving throw, the target(s) have advantage on the roll.

values.name: Nachtnebel
values.description: You hit a target with a necrotic wave of dark energy. Make a ranged attack against a target. On a hit, deal an amount of {type} damage equal to 1d6 + the user’s level.

values.name: Nachthieb
values.description: You slash out at a creature with dark power. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This attack scores a critical hit on natural attack rolls of 19 or 20.

values.name: Nachtmahr
values.description: You create a horrible nightmare in the mind of any sleeping creature in a {shape} around you, inflicting {dice} {type} damage automatically. This move does not wake a sleeping creature.

values.name: Finalformation
values.description: For the duration, you have advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. You cannot switch out or flee.

values.name: Kampfgebrüll
values.description: You let out a stunning roar that intimidates a target. When targeted by an attack, use this reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

values.name: Wangenrubbler
values.description: You touch a creature with your electrified cheeks, sending electricity coursing through their veins. Make a melee attack roll against a creature. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and is forced to make a {save}, becoming paralyzed on a failure.

values.name: Unheilsschwingen
values.description: You extend your wings and use a dark beam of energy to absorb the target's life force. Make a ranged attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit, recovering your own hit points by the amount of damage dealt.

values.name: Abblocker
values.description:
You sense incoming danger and are able to quickly avoid it. When you are the recipient of the damage and/or effects of a move, you may automatically avoid the damage/effects on the first instance of this reaction. On future instances of this move in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful. This reaction may not be used to guard against the damage/effects that result from a natural 20 attack roll.

If the attack was a melee attack, the attacker must make a {save}, flinching on failure. This flinch lasts for the rest of this turn and through the attacker's next turn.

values.name: Octazooka
values.description: You send a blast of ink towards your creatures. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target must add -1 to attack rolls for the remainder of this combat.

values.name: Octoklammer
values.description:
Make a grapple check against the target. When you succeed, the target's AC is reduced by 1. At the beginning of each of your turns, you may use a free action to reduce the AC of a target grappled with this move by 1. This may stack up to 5 times, for a total reduction of -5 AC.

The target's AC reduction resets to 0 once the grapple is released or broken.

values.name: Schnüffler
values.description: When you activate this move, choose a target in range. For the duration, the target cannot activate any move that would increase its AC. If it has already activated such a move, the effect ends immediately. In addition, for the duration, no creature in range has immunity to your Ghost, Normal, or Fighting-type moves.

values.name: Unheilböen
values.description: You stir up a gust of repulsive wind that strikes a creature in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, increase all of your ability scores by +1 while you remain in battle.

values.name: Order Up
values.description: Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If you have a Tatsugiri in your mouth, then an effect occurs depending on the form of Tatsugiri:

rows: This attack deals extra damage equal to your STR modifier.
You gain +3 AC until the start of your next turn.
You have advantage on DEX saves until the start of your next turn.

values.name: Ursprungswoge
values.description: Your body glows a bright and brilliant blue, sending three beams of focused light at any creature(s) in range. Make a ranged attack for each beam, dealing {dice} {type} damage on each successful hit.

values.name: Wutanfall
values.description: You go into a rampage, doing several attacks without control for three rounds. This move automatically hits for 1d6 + MOVE {type} damage in the first round, 2d6 + MOVE {type} damage in the second round, and 4d6 + MOVE {type} damage in the third round. When this move ends, either after the third round or from breaking concentration, you become confused. This attack stops if concentration is broken, or the user becomes incapacitated.

values.name: Overdrive
values.description: You create a deafening, explosive sound that damages all creatures within 20 feet of you. Force any creature in range to make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

values.name: Hitzekoller
values.description: With a roar, flames burst from your body in a {shape}, centered on you. Any creature in range must roll a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. The power of the move exhausts you, and your next attack is done at disadvantage. If your next attack requires a creature saving throw, they have advantage.

values.name: Leidteiler
values.description: You split pain from your injuries with your attacker. Target a creature in range, forcing them to make a {save}. On a fail, both you and your attacker change your current health points to the average of the two. If this causes either creature to go above maximum health, they take their maximum health instead.

values.name: Parabolladung
values.description: A sweeping electric charge arcs around you, stealing some of the target's energy. Force all creatures within 30 feet of you to make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure. Recover hit points equal to half the total damage dealt, but no more than 5 times your level.

values.name: Abgangstirade
values.description: You deliver a brutal parting threat just before switching out. Force a creature in range to make a {save}, then switch out immediately. On a failure, the target deals half damage on their next turn if using a damaging move.

values.name: Zahltag
values.description: You strike a target, causing it to shake out its purse. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. In addition, 10x the user’s level in cash is scattered on the floor until the end of combat. This release of funds can only occur once per target per combat.

values.name: Gegenstoß
values.description: You strike hard in retaliation. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target has dealt any damage to you since the end of your last turn, double the damage you deal.

values.name: Pikser
values.description: You hammer down on a target with a peck attack. Make a melee attack roll on a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a successful hit.

values.name: Abgesang
values.description: You perform a song with devastating consequences to creatures that hear it. All creatures in range (including you) must make a {save}. For any that fail, they faint in 3 rounds, on their turn, unless fleeing or switched out by their trainer before the end of the three rounds.

values.name: Blütenwirbel
values.description: You stir up a blizzard of sharp petals that swirl around you. Any creature within 30 feet of you must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

values.name: Blättertanz
values.description: You dance around, releasing a flurry of sharp leaf attacks against a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On the following turn, you may choose to use this action again to hit automatically, but if you do, you become confused at the end of your turn.

values.name: Phantomkraft
values.description: You disappear from view and prepare to surprise your target with an attack. When you activate this move, you become invisible and immune to any attacks of opportunity. You cannot be targeted by attacks while you are invisible. On your next turn, you use your action to reappear at a point in range and make a melee attack against a creature, with advantage, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a successful hit. Protect and Detect reactions may not be used when hit by this attack.

values.name: Photonen-Geysir
values.description: A pillar of light erupts from the ground in a 20ft radius, 80ft high cylinder centered on a point in range. Any creature caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. This move ignores any of the creatures abilities that would affect the user's ability to hit or deal full damage.

values.name: Nadelrakete
values.description: You strike a creature with sharp projectiles in quick succession. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, another projectile hits again for an additional 1d4 {type} damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.

values.name: Plasmafäuste
values.description: You charge up your firsts with electricity and lash out at a target. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, both you and your target's normal-type moves become electric-type until the end of your next turn.

values.name: Kameradschaft
values.description: You convince a creature that you mean it no harm. Force a creature to make a {save}. On a failure, any attack the target makes on its next turn is rolled at disadvantage. If the target activates a move that requires a saving throw, you have advantage on the roll.

values.name: Knuddler
values.description: You fake a creature out with a playful attack that quickly becomes too rough. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 19 or 20, the target adds -1 to any attack it makes for the remainder of combat. This effect can be stacked to a maximum of -5 to hit.

values.name: Pflücker
values.description: You peck at a target, attempting to grab their held berry. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, if the target is holding a berry, you swallow it immediately and gain its effect.

values.name: Giftzahn
values.description: You lash forward with poisonous venom. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit, forcing the target to make a {save}. On a failure, the creature is badly poisoned.

values.name: Giftwolke
values.description: You create a fog of poisonous gas in a 15 foot radius, centered on a point within range. Creatures that begin their turn in the area take {dice} {type} damage and must succeed on a {save} or become poisoned. The gas cloud dissipates at the beginning of your next turn.

values.name: Gifthieb
values.description: You stab a creature with an appendage steeped in poison. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 16 or higher, the target is poisoned.

values.name: Giftpuder
values.description: You release a cluster of poisonous spores that burst into the air above a target. The creature must succeed on a {save}, becoming poisoned on a fail.
values.optional: Instead of range 40ft, range is 5ft radius circle centered up to 40ft away.

values.name: Giftstachel
values.description: You strike out at a creature with a poisonous sting. Make a melee attack roll against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the creature is poisoned.
values.optional: Instead of natural roll of 18 or higher, target makes a CON save against your MOVE DC, becoming poisoned on failure.

values.name: Giftschweif
values.description: Poisonous barbs sprout from your tail as you swing it at a creature. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is a 19 or 20, the move scores a critical hit and the target is poisoned.

values.name: Pollenknödel
values.description: You send forth a flurry of pollen at a target in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target is an ally, this move automatically hits and heals for the amount of damage instead.

values.name: Poltergeist
values.description:
You attack by controlling the target's item. The target must make a {save} or lose a hold of their item. On a failed save, you may immediately make one melee attack against one creature within 5 feet of the item. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage.

As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of the item.

The item follows within 5 feet of its owner, hovering nearby. The creature cannot benefit from the item while you control it. The items's owner may use an action on its turn to try and regain control of the item by repeating the {save}, ending the move's concentration on a successful save.

values.name: Population Bomb
values.description: Your fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack. Make 10 melee attack rolls against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on each hit.

values.name: Pounce
values.description: You pounce at the target and leap away. Make a melee attack roll against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on hit. If you hit, you may move an additional 10ft without invoking an attack of opportunity.

values.name: Klaps
values.description: You crush a creature with a pound attack. Make a melee attack roll against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Pulverschleuder
values.description: You quickly coat a creature in an explosive powder. When a creature in range activates a fire-type move, you may use your reaction to release a spray of flammable powder that explodes and automatically deals {dice} typeless damage to the target.

values.name: Pulverschnee
values.description: You send a blast of cold snow at a creature. Make a ranged attack roll on a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or higher, the target is frozen.
values.optional: Instead of a natural roll of 18 or higher, target makes a CON save against your MOVE DC, becoming frozen on failure.

values.name: Juwelenkraft
values.description: A ray of light bursts out of your gemstone, damaging a creature in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Power Shift
values.description: You refocus your offense strategy. Until the start of your next turn, for the next Move you execute you may choose any attribute for its Move Power.

values.name: Kraftteiler
values.description: You use your psychic power to change your offense to match the target's the best you can. Force a creature in range to make a {save}. On a failure, choose either your STR, DEX, or WIS. For the duration, replace the chosen ability score with the average of your current score and the target's score.

values.name: Krafttausch
values.description: As a bonus action, force a creature in range to make a {save}. On a failure, you employ your psychic power to swap a single ability score with a creature until the end of their next turn, for purposes of attack and damage rolls.

values.name: Krafttrick
values.description: You employ your psychic power to switch your own attack and defense. Until the end of your next turn, switch your AC with an ability score of your choice (Constitution not included)

values.name: Überheblichkeit
values.description: You boast your strength and attack a target. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. For each unique stat change affecting the user, add an additional damage dice.
