values.name: Blattgeißel
values.description: You violently whirl your tentacles or vines towards a target. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit

values.name: Steigerungshieb
values.description: You strike out with a powerful punch that increases in strength the more you hit. Make a melee attack on a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a successful hit against the same creature. For each successful hit, add an additional damage dice, with a maximum number of damage dice equal to double the original amount. The damage resets if you miss or target a different creature.

values.name: Abgrundsklinge
values.description: You gather in the natural energy of the land around you and manifest all of the power into fearsome blades of stone. Make three ranged attack rolls against any creature(s) in range, dealing {dice} {type} damage on each successful hit.

values.name: Geschenk
values.description: You send a booby-trapped gift to a creature. Make a ranged attack on a creature in range. On a hit, the present explodes, doing {dice} {type} damage. If the natural attack roll is 2 or lower, however, regardless if it hits, the present provides the target with {dice} hit points instead.

values.name: Prisma-Laser
values.description: You use the power of a prism to fire a collection of dangerous lasers in a {shape}, 5ft wide.  Any creature caught in the line must succeed a {save} or take {dice} {type} damage on a fail, and half as much on a save.  This move cannot be used on consecutive turns by the same creature.

values.name: Schutzschild
values.description: You sense incoming danger and are able to quickly avoid it. When you are the recipient of the damage and/or effects of a move, you may automatically avoid the damage/effects on the first instance of this reaction. On future instances of this move in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful. This reaction may not be used to guard against the damage/effects that result from a natural 20 attack roll.

values.name: Psystrahl
values.description: You send a beam of invisible, psychic energy at a target in range. The target must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, or half as much on a success. Creatures that fail the save by 5 or more become confused.

values.name: Psychoschneide
values.description: You rend the target with an ethereal blade. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If you are on Electric Terrain, you make the attack with advantage.

values.name: Psycho-Plus
values.description: You sync up with a creature, copying any positive or negative stat changes affecting them due to weather or moves this combat.

values.name: Psychokinese
values.description: You tap into a target’s mind, damaging their will to fight. Make a ranged attack on a creature in range, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or higher, the target becomes confused.

values.name: Psychobeißer
values.description: You materialize a set of large fangs that bite at a creature with psychic energy. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.  On a hit, this move bypasses and ends Aurora Veil, and is not affected by Light Screen and Reflect.

values.name: Psycholärm
values.description: You attack the target with unpleasant sound waves. The target must make a {save}. On failure, the target takes {dice} {type} damage, and it can't regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn.

values.name: Psychofeld
values.description: Psychic energy emerges from the ground in a {shape}, centered on you. Begininng at the end of your turn, for three rounds, all grounded creatures in the affected area are unable to use bonus actions. Grounded creatures are those that do not have a flying speed or Levitate, Magnet Rise, or similar ability. In addition, creatures may double their MOVE modifier on damage rolls from psychic-type moves activated inside the area.

values.name: Psyschub
values.description: You send an extremely powerful wave of psychic energy at creatures in a {shape}. Creatures in the wave must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. The power of the move exhausts you, and your next attack is done at disadvantage. If your next attack requires a creature saving throw, they have advantage.

values.name: Psychoklinge
values.description: You tear at a target with blades formed by psychic power. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move scores a critical hit on natural rolls of 19 or 20.

values.name: Psybann
values.description: You employ your psychic power to transfer a status condition to someone else. Choose a willing ally (or yourself) and a creature in range. Force the target to make a {save}. on a failure, a status affecting the ally (or you) is transferred to the target instead.

values.name: Psyshield Bash
values.description: You cloak yourself in psychic energy before striking your target. Make a melee attack on a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Your AC is increased by 1 until the end of your next turn.

values.name: Psychoschock
values.description: You materialize a psychic wave that shocks a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Psychostoß
values.description: You materialize a psychic wave that shocks a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Psywelle
values.description: You emit a wave of psychic energy in a {shape}, 5 feet wide. Each creature caught in the wave must make a {save}, becoming confused on a fail.

values.name: Strafattacke
values.description: You send dark energy to punish a creature. Make a ranged attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target is currently under the influence of a move or ability that boosts its attack, damage, or AC, increase the damage by one damage dice for each effect.

values.name: Läuterung
values.description: You extend a healing energy to remove all status effects from a target. If a status effect is healed, it also restores the user's current hit points by twice its level. The user of this move cannot target itself.

values.name: Verfolgung
values.description: As a reaction, when a creature is fleeing or is switched out by their trainer, you may make a ranged attack roll against it, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Feuerball
values.description: The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball at the target. Make a ranged attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on hit. On hit, the target must make a {save}, becoming burned on failure.

values.name: Verzögerung
values.description: You send dark energy at a creature in range, reducing their will to fight. The target must make a {save}. On a failure, it must move to the bottom of the initiative order for this round only. Targets that have already taken their turn in this round are unaffected.

values.name: Ruckzuckhieb
values.description: You lash out with a quick unarmed strike at a creature in range. As a bonus action, you can immediately move up to 10ft and make a melee attack against a creature in range without taking an attack of opportunity, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Rapidschutz
values.description: You have the ability to rush to the aid of an ally at the start of combat. If an ally in range (or you) is attacked on the very first turn of the very first round of combat, you may use your reaction to negate any damage dealt.

values.name: Falterreigen
values.description: You lightly perform a mystical dance. For the duration, add +1 to your AC, attack rolls, and damage.
values.higherLevels: Add +2 to your AC at level 10 and above

values.name: Raserei
values.description: You go into a fit of rage, attacking with relentless fury. While you are raging, you gain +1 on all damage rolls (only once per move), have resistance to normal damage, and have advantage on all Strength checks. Your rage ends if you drop concentration or if your turn ends and you have not attacked a hostile target since your last turn, or taken any damage since then.
values.higherLevels: For damage when raging, the bonus changes to +2 at level 5, +4 at level 10, and +6 at level 17.

values.name: Rage Fist
values.description: You convert your rage into energy to attack. You make a melee attack against a creature in range, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move deals 1 additional damage for every 10 points of HP you have below your maximum HP.

values.name: Wutpulver
values.description: You scatter a cloud of irritating powder, drawing attacks to yourself. Any creature in a {shape} must make a {save}. On a failure, the creature(s) can only use damaging moves that target you for the duration. Any creature affected can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to shake off the effect.

values.name: Raging Bull
values.description:
You tackle like a raging bull. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} damage on a hit. This move ignores the effects of moves that would reduce its damage (Harden, Reflect, etc.).

The type of damage dealt by this move depends on the breed of its user.

values.name: Raging Fury
values.description:
You go into a rampage, spewing flames about for three rounds. For up to three rounds while concentrating, make a ranged attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Concentration ends at the end of the third round after activing this move, when you miss with this move, or fail to use this move; you cannot lose concentration on Raging Fury as a result of taking damage, and you cannot willingly drop concentration. While concentrating, you may only attack with Raging Fury.

When concentration ends, you become confused.

values.name: Regentanz
values.description: You summon a heavy rainfall that covers the battlefield for 5 rounds.

values.name: Turbodreher
values.description: You strike out with an incredibly fast spinning move. All creatures within melee range must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. In addition, this move automatically frees the user from Leech Seed or anything causing it to be grappled or restrained. It is removed from these statuses before the saving throw is made.

values.name: Rasierblatt
values.description: You send a razor sharp leaf at a creature in range at tremendous speed. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Razor Leaf results in a critical hit on 19s and 20s

values.name: Kalkklinge
values.description: You strike a creature with a razor sharp shell. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 18 or higher, lower the creatures AC by 1. This decrease may be stacked, up to a maximum of -5 to AC.

values.name: Klingensturm
values.description: When you use this move, strong winds begin to circle around you, granting +2 to AC. On your next turn, if you keep your concentration, you release those winds as an action in a {shape}, centered on you. Each creature in the area must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, or half as much on a success.

values.name: Genesung
values.description: You extend a healing energy to recover the hit points of yourself or a creature in range. The target regains {dice} hit points.

values.name: Aufbereitung
values.description: You summon a previously discarded item back into your hands. If you used a consumable held item any time within the last 5 turns, you can activate this move to take advantage of the same effect one last time. This move may not be used in the same round the held item was used.

values.name: Reflektor
values.description: When you are subject to a melee attack, use your reaction to take half the damage dealt now and on any melee attack that targets you until the beginning of your next turn.

values.name: Typenspiegel
values.description: Your body flashes into a mirror for just a moment. When it returns to normal, you take on the type of a creature in range.

values.name: Heilung
values.description: A wave of healing energy washes over you, curing poison, paralysis, and burn.

values.name: Urgesang
values.description: You sing an ancient song that damages creatures in range with the chance to put them asleep. Any creature within 20 feet of you must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much ona success. Any creature that fails the save by 5 or more is put to sleep.

values.name: Erholung
values.description: When you activate this move, you fall asleep after the end of your turn, but recover {dice} hit points in the process. You do not regain health if you do not fall asleep.

values.name: Heimzahlung
values.description: You rush to avenge a fallen ally. When a creature causes an ally to faint, you may move up to your speed to immediately rush forward and make a melee attack roll on the target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Rückkehr
values.description: You lash out at a creature, in hopes it will please your trainer. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. When you make this attack, add an additional bonus to hit and damage equal to the number of levels you are above zero on the Loyalty Chart.

values.name: Wecktanz
values.description:
You strike out at a target with an aggressive dance. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE damage on a hit. The type of this move and its damage matches the user's current Primary Type, receiving STAB accordingly. If the Primary Type is lost (for example, due to Burn Up), then the Secondary Type is used instead, if it has one, or typeless (with no STAB bonus) if it doesn't.

If the user is terastallized with a non-Stellar type, then the type and damage of this move becomes that of the user's Tera Type instead.

values.name: Vergeltung
values.description: You invoke a fight within to retaliate against a creature that damages you. As a reaction, when you are hit with a melee attack that deals damage, make a melee attack roll against your attacker, with disadvantage. On a hit, deal the same amount of fighting type damage back at your attacker (maximum of 5x your current level).

values.name: Gegenschlag
values.description: You unleash an all out attack that is stronger the less HP you have. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If you are below 50% of your maximum health, double the damage. If you are at 10% or below of your maximum health, triple the damage instead. The multiplier for this attack occurs before the multiplier for resistances or vulnerabilities.

values.name: Revival Blessing
values.description: You bestow a loving blessing on a target feinted Pokémon. Half of the target's HP is restored.

values.name: Hochspannung
values.description:
You attack with electric voltage rising from the ground. The target creature must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on failure or half on success.

If you are in electric terrain, then all other ceatures in the same electric terrain become targets of this move, up to 60ft from you.

values.name: Brüller
values.description: You release an intimidating roar at all opponents within 15 feet of you. Opponents that can hear you must make a {save}. On a fail, the creature is frightened and is forced to immediately move up to its speed in a straight line away from you, or until met with an impeding force (does not provoke attacks of opportunity). A creature frightened in this way must make a {save} at the end of each of its turns to remove the effect.

values.name: Zeitenlärm
values.description: You unleash a roar that has the power to distort time. All creatures within 40 feet of you must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. For any creature that failed the save by 5 or more, you may immediately take another action against them. Roar of Time may not be used as one of the additional actions. This move drains you of energy, and you may not make any attack until after the end of your next turn.

values.name: Felswurf
values.description: You summon a series of rocks that fire their way towards a creature. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 {type} damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.

values.name: Kraxler
values.description: You charge at a target with an attack that attempts to confuse. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 17 or higher, the target becomes confused.

values.name: Steinpolitur
values.description: You polish your body to a fine shine to reduce friction. When activating this move, increase your AC by 2 and your speed by 20 feet for three rounds.

values.name: Steinhagel
values.description: Large boulders appear above a target creature in range, crashing down on top of them. The target must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage and falling prone on a failed save, and half as much without falling prone on a success.

values.name: Zertrümmerer
values.description: You strike out with a rock-crushing attack that may lower a user’s defense. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 19 or 20, the target’s AC decreases by 1 while it remains in battle.

values.name: Steinwurf
values.description: You hurl a rock at a target in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Felsgrab
values.description: You summon a collection of boulders that attempt to surround a target. Force a creature in range to make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage and becoming restrained on a failure, or half as much without being restrained on a success. If it fails, at the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a {save}. While a creature is restrained, you may continue this move, as an action, to deal an automatic {dice} {type} damage.

values.name: Felswerfer
values.description: You summon a huge boulder and launch it at a target in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move saps you of energy, and may not activate it again until after the end of your next turn.

values.name: Rollenspiel
values.description: You attempt to copy a creature's abilities for the duration. Select a target in range and force them to make a {save}. On a failure, replace one of your own current abilities with one of theirs.

values.name: Fegekick
values.description: You swing your feet around in a wide arc to strike a target. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target flinches.

values.name: Walzer
values.description: You roll into a target, repeatedly making attacks with increasing strength. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing 1d6 + MOVE {type} damage on a hit. If you use this move on your turn in consecutive rounds, double the dice on each successful attack for a maximum of 5 attacks, in which case the damage would reset. Ex: 1d6 on first hit, 2d6 on second, 4d6, 8d6, 16d6. The damage resets if any of the attacks fail to damage a creature, if your speed is reduced to 0, or if you are incapacitated.

values.name: Ruheort
values.description: You land on the ground to rest your body. When activated, your flying speed decreases to zero, and you lose your flying type for as long as you remain on the ground. At the beginning of your next turn, if you have not left the ground, recover {dice} hit points.

values.name: Pflüger
values.description: You imbue the ground around you with a mystical layer of natural energy, like tilling fresh soil. For three rounds, grass-type creatures double their STAB bonus when activating a grass-type move within the affected area.

values.name: Kanon
values.description: You attack a creature's mind with a harsh song. Select a target in range and force them to make a {save}. On a failure, the target takes {dice} {type} damage. If an ally in range also knows this move, they can join in the song as a reaction to add an additional damage dice.

values.name: Ruination
values.description: You summon ruinous disaster on a creature you can see in range. The target must make a {save}. On a failed save, it loses half of its current HP, and its Hit Point maximum is reduced by the amount of HP lost.

values.name: Läuterfeuer
values.description: You unleash a devastating, concentrated blast of flame at a single target in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 10 or more, the target is burned.

values.name: Sanctoklinge
values.description: You attempt to pierce a creature with one of your sharp appendages. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move ignores any boosts affecting the target's AC.

values.name: Bodyguard
values.description: You and all allies in range boost their defense. For the duration, anyone affected is protected from any new negative status conditions.

values.name: Salt Cure
values.description:
You salt cure the target, dealing damage over time. Choose a target in range. The target must make a {save}. On failure, the target takes {dice} {type} damage, and it takes 1d4 {type} damage at the start of each of its turns until it is returned to a Pokéball or receives healing.

Water- and Steel-type Pokémon are vulnerable to the damage dealt by this move.

values.name: Sandwirbel
values.description: You kick up a cloud of sand in an attempt to blind a target in range. The target must make a {save}. On a fail, for the remainder of the encounter, they add -1 to all of their attack rolls. This move can be stacked for a maximum of -5 to attack rolls.
values.optional: Instead of range 30ft, range is 5ft radius circle centered up to 30ft away.

values.name: Sandgrab
values.description: You attempt to summon a wave of sand that surrounds the target. Force a creature in range to make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage and becoming restrained on a failure, or half as much without being restrained on a success. If it fails, at the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a {save}. While a creature is restrained, you may continue this move, as an action, to deal an automatic {dice} {type} damage.

values.name: Sandsear Storm
values.description:
You create a storm of fierce winds and searingly hot sand with the size of a 40-foot-cube centered on a point in range. Each enemy creature in the area makes a {save}. On a failed save, it takes {dice} {type} damage and becomes Burned. On a successful save, it takes half the damage and does not become Burned.

A creature also makes that save if it enters the area or ends it turn there. A creature makes that save only once per turn.

When used during the rain, creatures have disadvantage on the save.

values.name: Sandsturm
values.description: You stir up a massive sandstorm in a 50 foot radius, centered on a point in range. When a non rock-, steel-, or ground-type creature enters the area for the first time on their turn, or begins their turn inside the area, they take an amount of rock damage equal to half your level, rounded up. The Sandstorm lasts for 5 rounds.

values.name: Siedewasser
values.description: You instantly boil water within you to a damaging temperature, blasting a creature with its heat. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 16 or more, the target is burned.

values.name: Schuppenschuss
values.description:
You blast your scales at a foe in range. Make five ranged attacks against one target in range. On each hit, deal 1d4 {type} damage; if any attack hit, deal an additional MOVE {type} damage (maximum once).

Until the end of your next turn, you have +10ft of movement and -2 AC.

values.name: Grimasse
values.description: You put on your scariest face, attempting to frighten a creature. The creature must make a {save} or become frightened for the duration. A creature frightened in this way must make a {save} at the end of each of its turns to remove the effect.

values.name: Brandsand
values.description: You throw scorching sand at a target to burn them. Make a ranged attack against a creature within 40 feet. On a hit, you deal {dice} {type} damage, and the target must make a {save}, becoming Burned on a failure.

values.name: Kratzer
values.description: You slash out at a creature in range. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Kreideschrei
values.description: You let out a horrible screech at creatures in a {shape}, centered on you. The creatures must make a {save}. On a fail, allies add +1 to any attack they target an affected creature with for the duration. This modifier can be stacked if a creature fails multiple screech saves, up to a maximum of +3.

values.name: Flammenball
values.description: Searing hot flames lick out at creatures in a {shape}, centered on you. Any creature in range must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a target fails the save by 5 or more, it is burned.

values.name: Geheimpower
values.description: You strike a target with unknown power. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 15 or higher, roll a d6 and cause the random effect.

values.name: Mystoschwert
values.description: You attempt to pierce a creature with one of your sharp appendages. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move ignores any boosts affecting the target's AC.

values.name: Samenbomben
values.description: You fire a series of hard seeds that crash down on top of a creature in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Schocksamen
values.description: You release a bright shockwave from your body, damaging all creatures within 20 feet of you. Any creature in range must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Until the end of your next turn, any attack roll made against a target that failed is rolled at advantage.

values.name: Geowurf
values.description: You attempt to throw a creature into the ground with tremendous force. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, deal an amount of {type} damage equal to 1d6 + the user’s level. Seismic Toss results in a critical hit on 19s and 20s.

values.name: Finale
values.description: You release a massive explosion in a {shape}, fainting immediately before the damage is dealt. Creatures in the area must make a {save}. If your creature has at least half its hit points left, anyone in range takes {dice} {type} damage on a fail, or half as much on a success. If your creature has less than half of its hit points left, the damage is halved for a failed save, and quartered for a success.

values.name: Spukball
values.description: You hurl a sphere of magical darkness at a creature. Make a ranged attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the ball expands and covers the creatures face, granting them a -2 to hit on any attack they make before the end of their next turn.

values.name: Schattenknochen
values.description: You strike out with a bone-infused wayward spirit. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 18 or higher, the target’s AC is decreased by 1 while it remains in battle. This decrease may be stacked up to a maximum of -5 to AC.

values.name: Dunkelklaue
values.description: You strike with a sharp claw made from shadows in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This moves scores a critical hit on natural attack rolls of 19 and 20.

values.name: Schemenkraft
values.description: You disappear from view and prepare to surprise a target with an attack. When you activate this move, you become invisible and immune to any attacks of opportunity. You cannot be targeted by attacks while you are invisible. On your next turn, you may use your action to reappear at a point within range and make a melee attack against a creature, with advantage, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a successful hit. Protect and Detect reactions may not be used when hit by this attack.

values.name: Finsterfaust
values.description: You throw a punch from the surrounding shadows, unavoidable by any creature. This move is guaranteed to hit for {dice} {type} damage, unless during the invulnerable stage of Fly, Dig, Bounce, Dive, etc. moves.

values.name: Schattenstoß
values.description: You extend your shadow to strike a creature from behind. As a bonus action, you can control your shadow to make a melee attack roll against a target within range, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Schärfer
values.description: You collect your focus, sharpening your combat skills. You may add 1d4 to all attack rolls for the duration.
values.higherLevels: The dice roll for this move changes to 1d6 at level 10.

values.name: Shed Tail
values.description: When hit with an attack, you may use your reaction to take 2d6 typeless damage in order to negate the damage and effects of the attack. If you do, you must switch out of battle as a free action.

values.name: Eiseskälte
values.description: You send a chill down the spine of a creature, freezing its core. Choose a target in range and roll a d20. On a 20, the target faints. On any other roll, this move has no effect. If the target's level is 10 more than your own, this move automatically fails.

values.name: Muschelwaffe
values.description: You fire acidic ooze from your side-arm. Make a ranged attack on a creature in range, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the target makes a {save}, becoming poisoned on failure.

values.name: Hausbruch
values.description: You break off a piece of your shell, lowering your defense but improving your attack. For the duration, lower your AC by 1, but add proficiency to all damage rolls (once per move). This move is not stackable.

values.name: Panzerfalle
values.description: You set a shell trap that explodes in a {shape}. As a bonus action on the initial activation of this move, you set a trap on yourself. Only one trap may be set at a time. When you are hit by an attack, you can use a reaction to detonate the trap. Creatures within 5 feet of you must succeed on a {save}, rolling at disadvantage, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

values.name: Shelter
values.description: As a reaction to being hit by an attack, you make your skin as hard as an iron shield. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack.

values.name: Gangwechsel
values.description: You rotate your gears quickly, raising your attack and speed. When you activate this move, add +1 to your attack and damage rolls, and +10 to your speed for the duration.

values.name: Schockwelle
values.description: A burst of electric energy glides forward, striking anything in a {shape}. This move is guaranteed to hit all creatures caught in the wave for {dice} {type} damage, unless during the invulnerable stage of Fly, Dig, Bounce, Dive, etc. moves.

values.name: Sandsammler
values.description: You use the power of the earth around you to help heal your wounds, recovering {dice} hit points. If used during a Sandstorm, your MOVE modifier is doubled.

values.name: Ampelleuchte
values.description: A flashing beam strikes a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the beam confuses the target.
values.optional: Instead of natural roll of 19 or 20, target makes a WIS save against your MOVE DC, becoming confused on failure.

values.name: Silk Trap
values.description:
You spin a silked trap for your opponent. When you are the recipient of the damage and/or effects of a move at melee range, you may automatically avoid the damage/effects. Additionally, the attacker must make a {save}, becoming Restrained on failure until the end of their next turn.

This reaction may not be used to guard against the damage/effects that result from a natural 20 attack roll.

values.name: Silberhauch
values.description: You strike a target with a battering wind of silver dust. Make a ranged attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural roll of 19 or 20, all of your ability scores go up by 1 while you remain in battle. This move can be stacked for a maximum of +5 to all ability scores.

values.name: Wankelstrahl
values.description: You use a mysterious psychic energy to change a target's ability to Simple. Force a target in range to make a {save}. On a failure, choose one of the target's abilities and change it to Simple for the duration.

values.name: Gesang
values.description: You sing a beautiful song in an attempt to put creatures to to sleep. Roll 5d8; the total is how many hit points of creature this move can affect. creatures within 30 feet of you are affected in ascending order of their current hit points. Starting with the creature that has the lowest current hit points, each creature affected by this move falls asleep. Subtract each creature’s hit points from the total before moving on to the creature with the next lowest hit points. A creature’s hit points must be equal to or less than the remaining total for that creature to be affected.
values.higherLevels: The number of hit points affected changes to 7d8 at level 5, 6d12 at level 10, and 11d8 at level 17.

values.name: Nachahmer
values.description: When any move is activated within sight of you, use a reaction to copy it to your move list, replacing it with one instance of Sketch in your current move list permanently. Sketch may not be used to copy a Signature or Legendary-only Move.

values.name: Fähigkeitstausch
values.description: You attempt to swap abilities with a creature for the duration. Select a target in range and force them to make a {save}. On a failure, choose which abilities to switch for the duration.

values.name: Krabbelkracher
values.description:
You skitter behind the target to attack. Make a melee attack roll against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the attack roll was made with advantage, you deal an extra Xd6 {type} damage, where X is your current level divided by two, rounded up (e.g. at level 11, you deal an additional 6d6 damage).

You don't need Advantage on the attack roll if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the target, the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition, and you don't have Disadvantage on the attack roll.
values.higherLevels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d10 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 5d4 at level 17. This dice change does NOT apply to the extra Xd6 damage dealt when triggered.

values.name: Schädelwumme
values.description: When you use this move, you lower your head and prepare to strike a target within range. On your next turn’s action, if you keep your concentration, you charge at a creature in range, ignoring your walking speed and any opportunity attacks you may incur. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. A creature hit with this attack must succeed on a {save} or be knocked prone.

values.name: Himmelsfeger
values.description: When you use this move, you flap your wings menacingly and prepare to strike a creature within range. On your next turn’s action, if you keep your concentration, you dive at a creature in range, ignoring your flying speed and any opportunity attacks you may incur. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Freier Fall
values.description: You reach out in an attempt to lift a creature up in the air for a slamming attack. When you activate this move, make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target is grappled. The target may use its next action to attempt a {save} to get free. If it does not succeed, and you maintain your concentration, you may use your action on your next turn to lift the creature into the air, dropping it to the ground for {dice} {type} damage. Flying-type creatures or ones under the effect of Levitate, Magnet Rise or other similar abilities/moves are not damaged.

values.name: Himmelhieb
values.description: You unleash a devastating uppercutting fist that continues to strike skyward with force. Make a ranged attack roll against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move can target creatures in the invulnerable stages of Fly, Bounce and Sky Drop, if the target used that move within range.

values.name: Tagedieb
values.description: You give yourself a break, healing your wounds. When you activate this move, you become incapacitated immediately and through your next two turns. Your trainer may not switch you out during this time. At the end of the second turn, regain half of your maximum hit points and become stable once again.

values.name: Slam
values.description: You crush a creature with a slam attack. Make a melee attack roll against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Schlitzer
values.description: You slash out at a creature in range. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Slash results in a critical hit on 19s and 20s.

values.name: Schlafpuder
values.description: You release a cluster of spores at a creature in range, attempting to put them to sleep. The target must make a {save} or fall asleep.

values.name: Schlafrede
values.description: This move can only be used if you are asleep. While asleep, activate a random move from your move list (not Sleep Talk) that has a move time of 1 action.

values.name: Schlammbad
values.description: You spew poisonous sludge at a target creature in range. Make a ranged attack. On a hit, deal {dice} {type} damage, and the creature must make a {save} or become poisoned.

values.name: Matschbombe
values.description: You hurl a mass of sludge that may poison creatures in its blast. Make a ranged attack roll against a target. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and the area in a 5 foot radius around it is covered in sludge until the beginning of your next turn. Any creature that enters this area for the first time on their turn, or is in that area at the beginning of their turn must make a {save} or become poisoned.

values.name: Schlammwoge
values.description: You summon a wave of poisonous sludge that crashes down on creatures in a {shape}. Any creature caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a creature fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it becomes poisoned.

values.name: Katapult
values.description: You throw a solid piece of stone at a creature in an attempt to bring them to the ground. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, any "Raised" creature is knocked prone and loses its flying speed and immunity to ground-type moves until it can move again. This move can target creatures in the invulnerable stage of Fly or Bounce.

values.name: Schmalhorn
values.description: You pinpoint the perfect place to strike a creature with a horn as strong as steel. This move is guaranteed to hit for {dice} {type} damage, unless during the invulnerable stage of Fly, Dig, Bounce, Dive, etc. moves.

values.name: Riechsalz
values.description: You procure a handful of strong smelling salt, damaging a creature's senses. Make a ranged attack against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target is paralyzed, double the dice roll for the damage.

values.name: Smog
values.description: You release a toxic cloud of poisonous smog in a 10 foot radius, centered on a point within range. Any creature that starts their turn in this area must succeed on a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Creatures that fail this save by 5 or more become poisoned.

values.name: Rauchwolke
values.description: You conjure a line of smoke on the battlefield, 60 feet long and 5 feet thick, that extends in any direction from a point within range. The area on either side is obscured and imposes disadvantage on any ranged attacks made by a creature targeting another on the opposite side. Any creature inside the wall of smoke, when it is conjured, must make a {save} or become blinded for the duration. A blinded creature can repeat the save at the beginning of its turns to remove the effect on a success.

values.name: Fangeisen
values.description:
You attempt to snare the target in a snap trap. One creature in melee range must make a {save}. On failure, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and is grappled by you.

When this move is used as an attack of opportunity against a creature moving out of your range, the target makes the save at disadvantage.

values.name: Standpauke
values.description: You release a harsh growl at a creature, damaging their willpower. Force a creature to make a {save}. On a failure, the target takes {dice} {type} damage, and if you are the target of its next attack, the attack is rolled at disadvantage.

values.name: Übernahme
values.description: You call upon dark energy to steal an effect from a creature. When a creature in range activates a move with a positive effect on itself (curing negative status effect, boosting stats, healing, etc.), force it to make a {save}. On a failure, you gain the positive effect and the target's move fails.

values.name: Präzisionsschuss
values.description: You snipe your foe with a high-velocity stream of water. Make a ranged attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on hit. If the attack was made with advantage, double the damage dice.

values.name: Schnarcher
values.description: While you are asleep, you may activate this move to create a harsh noise that damages all creatures within range for {dice} {type} damage.

values.name: Snowscape
values.description: You cover the battlefield in a snowstorm. While concentrating, Ice-type creatures in range have +1 to AC.
values.higherLevels: The AC bonus for this move changes to +2 at level 5, +3 at level 10, and +4 at level 17.

values.name: Überflutung
values.description: You fire a torrent of water at a creature that leaves lasting effects. Force a target in range to make a {save}. On a failure, its type changes to water through its next three full turns in battle.

values.name: Weichei
values.description: Heal a creature in range for {dice} hitpoints.

values.name: Solarstrahl
values.description: When you use this move, soak in solar energy and prepare to unleash a devastating beam. On your next turn, if you keep your concentration, use an action to create a {shape} of solar energy, 5 feet wide. Any creature caught in the line must succeed on a {save} or take {dice} {type} damage on a fail and half as much on a save. If this move is used in harsh sunlight, double your MOVE modifier for damage and it can be used on the turn it is activated, without concentration.

values.name: Solarklinge
values.description: When you activate this move, you use your action gathering in solar energy to prepare to strike with blades.  On your next turn, if you keep your concentration, use an action to make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If this move is used in harsh sunlight, double your MOVE modifier for damage and it can be used on the turn it is activated, without concentration.

values.name: Ultraschall
values.description: You unleash a deafening sound that harms creatures in a {shape}, centered on you. Creatures in range must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, or half as much on a success. The damage dealt by this move can't be modified in any way, such as by resistance, bonus damage, or damage reduction (but can be prevented by immunity).

values.name: Raumschlag
values.description: You release a powerful shockwave that tears through creatures and the space around them. All creatures within 30 feet of you must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Creatures that fail this save by 5 or more become uncontrollable and are sucked into the Ethereal Plane until the beginning of your next turn, appearing in the same location when they return.

values.name: Funkensprung
values.description: You strike out with an electrified tackle with a chance to paralyze a target. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or higher, the target is paralyzed.

values.name: Schaumserenade
values.description: You burst into song, unleashing a flurry of bubbles in a {shape}, centered on you. All creatures in range must make a {save} or take {dice} {type} damage on a fail and half as much on a save. Any creature suffering from the burned condition will be cured upon touching the bubbles.

values.name: Diebesschatten
values.description: You succumb to darkness and transport yourself into a creature's shadow. Immediately teleport to a point in range and make a melee attack on a creature. On hit, you steal all positive stat changes affecting the creature and deal {dice} {type} damage.

values.name: Initiativetausch
values.description: You use your psychic power to swap speed with a creature.  Force a creature in range to make a {save}. On a failure, switch speed with the target for the duration.

values.name: Spicy Extract
values.description: You emit an incredibly spicy extract. All creatures in range must make a {save}. Creatures that fail the save, for the duration, make all attacks with advantage, and all attacks against them are made with advantage.

values.name: Spinnennetz
values.description: You fire a sticky web that attempts to restrain a creature. Make a ranged attack roll on a target in range. On a hit, the target is covered in web. While covered, it is restrained and cannot flee or be switched out, except by item, Move, or ability. The target can use an action on its turn to escape with a {save}.

values.name: Dornkanone
values.description: You fire a series of sharp spikes at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 {type} damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.

values.name: Stachler
values.description: You set a trap of spikes that hurts creature that come into battle. If a trainer is in range and switches out a creature, you can spend a reaction to make a ranged attack on the incoming creature with spikes that come out of the ground, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Schutzstacheln
values.description: You quickly raise a spiked shield to protect yourself from damage. When you are hit by a melee attack, use your reaction to ignore damage, dealing grass damage equal to your proficiency modifier to the attacker instead. On future instances of this reaction in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful.

values.name: Spin Out
values.description: You spin furiously by straining your legs. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Until the beginning of your next turn, you have disadvantage on all DEX saves and your speed is halved.

values.name: Seelenbruch
values.description: You attack with so much force it breaks the target's spirit. Make a melee attack against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. The target has disadvantage on its next attack.

values.name: Schattenfessel
values.description: You employ dark energy to stitch a creature’s shadow to the ground.  Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.  On hit, the target is unable to flee or switch out while the user remains in battle.

values.name: Entfessler
values.description: The power of energy stored by Stockpile is released against a target. Make a ranged attack against a creature, dealing a base {dice} {type} damage on a hit. The dice roll is doubled if two rounds of energy were Stockpiled. The dice roll is tripled if three rounds of energy were Stockpiled.

values.name: Groll
values.description: When hit with an attack, you can spend a reaction to attempt to drain the attacker’s PP, if they are in range. Force the attacker to make a {save}. On a fail, roll a d4. The PP of the move that attacked you is decreased by that number.
values.higherLevels: PP is drained by 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 1d10 at level 17.

values.name: Platscher
values.description: You flail around on the ground, doing no damage and looking ridiculous, but you can leap up to 50 feet in the air.

values.name: Pilzspore
values.description: When you are targeted by a melee attack, you can use your reaction to release a spore that attempts to put your attacker to sleep. The creature must make a {save}, falling asleep on a fail.

values.name: Rampenlicht
values.description: You shine a bright light on a creature in range that follows them around the battlefield. The target must make a {save}. On a fail, attacks against that creature have advantage for the duration.

values.name: Springtide Storm
values.description:
You create a storm brimming with love an hate with the size of a 40-foot-cube centered on a point in range. Each enemy creature in the area makes a {save}. On a failed save, it takes {dice} {type} damage and has disadvantage on all attack rolls it makes until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half the damage and does not get disadvantage.

A creature also makes that save if it enters the area or ends it turn there. A creature makes that save only once per turn.

values.name: Tarnsteine
values.description: You quickly summon a trap of sharp rocks that hurts a creature entering the battle. When a creature is switched into battle, you may use your reaction to make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage to the incoming creature on a hit.

values.name: Dampfschwall
values.description: You shoot out a cone of intensely hot steam from your body, immersing creatures in range. Any creature in the area must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a target fails the save by 5 or more, it becomes burned.

values.name: Quetschwalze
values.description: You roll up your body and roll over a creature. Make a melee attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If your natural attack roll is 15 or higher, the target flinches.

values.name: Stahlstrahl
values.description:
You fire a beam of steel that is collected from your entire body in an {shape}, 5 feet wide. Any creature caught in the line must succeed on a {save} or take {dice} {type} damage on a fail and half as much on a save.

The recoil of using this move sends you backward 10 feet opposite of the direction the beam was targetted, and you fall prone. If you were grounded when using this move, you take 2d6 typeless damage. If you were flying or hovering, calculate fall damage accordingly.

values.name: Eisenwalze
values.description: You attack while destroying terrain. This move may only be used if there is active terrain (e.g. Electric Terrain, Psychic Terrain, etc). Use 30ft of your movement. Each creature that comes within 5ft of you during your movement must make a {save}. On a failure, the creature takes {dice} {type} damage, half on success. Additionally, the active terrain is removed.

values.name: Stahlflügel
values.description: You strike a target hard with outstretched wings. Make a melee attack on a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 19 or 20, your AC is increased by 1 until the end of your next turn.

values.name: Klebenetz
values.description: You quickly fire a sticky web at a creature entering the battle. When a creature is switched into battle, you may use your reaction to make a ranged attack on the creature. On a hit, the target is restrained. The creature may make a {save} at the beginning of each of its turns to escape the web.

values.name: Horter
values.description: You use your action to store energy for a Spit Up or Swallow move, increasing your defense. Raise your AC by 1 until you use one of those two moves. This move may be stacked a maximum of 3 times before the energy is used.

values.name: Stampfer
values.description: You raise your feet up for a stomp attack. Make a melee attack roll against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target flinches.

values.name: Fruststampfer
values.description: Driven by frustration, you aggressively attack.  Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.  If you last attack missed, double the dice roll for damage.

values.name: Stone Axe
values.description:
You swing your stone axes at the target. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

On a successful hit, spikes cover the ground in a 10-foot square centered on the target, turning it into Difficult Terrain for 1 minute. When the spikes appear, each creature standing in the area except for the creature using this move must succeed on a {save} or suffer 1d10 {type} damage. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed or take the damage.

values.name: Steinkante
values.description: The earth moves beneath a target’s feet as sharp stone pierce through the ground underneath them. Creatures in a 10 foot radius centered on a point you choose in range must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, or half as much on a save.

values.name: Kraftvorrat
values.description: You use your psychic energy to attack with stored power. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Add an additional damage dice for each stat-changing effect currently applied to the user. (For example, if you or an ally has activated a move(s) that is currently boosting the user's AC, speed, and STAB, add three additional damage dice. A move that affects multiple ability scores is considered "one" effect for this boost)

values.name: Bergsturm
values.description: You strike a target with a fierce blow. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If a target is immune to the damage from critical hits, halve the damage dealt by this attack.

values.name: Wunderdampf
values.description: The user attacks targets in the area by emitting steam. Each creature in the line must make a {save}. A creature takes {dice} {type} damage and becomes confused on a failed save. On a success, they take half damage and are not confused.

values.name: Stärke
values.description: You strike out at a creature with brute strength. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, you may also choose to push the creature 5 feet away.

values.name: Kraftabsorber
values.description: If a creature attempts to use a move that boosts its stats, you may use your reaction to negate the increase and convert it into healing energy, recovering regain {dice} hit points.  This includes critical hit bonuses, AC increases, speed, attack and damage boosts, etc.

values.name: Fadenschuss
values.description: You unleash sticky string at a creature in range, slowing it down. Make a ranged attack roll against a target. On a hit, the target’s speed is reduced by 10 for the duration. The move is stackable to any amount. The target may take an action to attempt to get rid of all accumulated string with a {save}. If this reduction in speed causes their speed to be 0, they are restrained.

values.name: Verzweifler
values.description: This move is known by all Pokémon, and can be used at any time. You lash out with an unarmed strike, or use an improvised weapon up close or at range to damage a creature. Make a melee or ranged (60 feet) attack roll, doing damage equal to 2 + MOVE typeless damage on a hit. The damage from this move cannot be increased by another move, item, or ability.

values.name: Käfertrutz
values.description: You resist an attack, fighting back against a creature. When hit by a melee attack, you may use a reaction to immediately retaliate with an attack roll of your own, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Backenstopfer
values.description: You consume a held food item, gaining its effects. In addition, your AC increases by 2 for 10 minutes. The max bonus AC you can gain this way is 4. This move works even in the presence of Unnerve or Magic Room.

values.name: Stachelspore
values.description: When you are subject to a melee attack, you can use your reaction to release a spore that attempts to stun your attacker. The creature must make a {save}, becoming paralyzed on a fail.

values.name: Überroller
values.description: You attempt a forceful grapple on a target. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit, but taking a quarter of the damage dealt in recoil. On a hit, the target is grappled. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a {save}. While a creature is grappled, this move can be activated again as a bonus action with an automatic hit, dealing 2d6 {type} damage with a quarter of the damage dealt in typeless recoil.

values.name: Delegator
values.description: You surrender a quarter of your current HP (rounded down) into temporary hit points in the form of a shield. During this time, the shield grants you immunity to NEW negative conditions (including things like prone, restrained, etc.) and it absorbs all outside damage that you would normally take until it is destroyed. The shield is considered "typeless" for damage resistance, vulnerability, and immunities. The shield and user cannot be healed while active, and it does not absorb self-inflicted conditions or damage caused by pre-existing burn, poison, or confusion. The shield breaks when it is reduced to 0 hit points, and the user takes the overflow damage. Sound- based moves bypass the shield (Supersonic, Grass Whistle, etc.)

values.name: Tiefschlag
values.description: You lay in a quick punch before a creature has a chance to attack. When targeted by a melee attack, you may use your reaction to attempt to strike a creature before its attack is rolled. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Sonnentag
values.description: You change the weather to harsh sunlight for 5 rounds.

values.name: Stahlgestirn
values.description: You slam into the target with the force of a meteor.  Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.  This move ignores any abilities of the target creature that would decrease its ability to hit or deal full damage.

values.name: Superzahn
values.description: You lash out with an incredible fang attack. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On critical hits, instead of doubling the dice, you can choose to do damage equal to half the target’s current HP (up to a maximum of 5x your level)..

values.name: Donnerstoß
values.description: You electrify your body and drop onto the target. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a miss, you take typeless damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

values.name: Kraftkoloss
values.description: You strike a target with incredible power - but with great power comes great responsibility. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. This move exhausts you, and your STR and DEX ability scores are both reduced by 10 until after the end of your next turn.

values.name: Superschall
values.description: You emit a high pitched screech heard only by the target. Choose a target in range. The target must pass a {save} or become confused.
values.optional: Change range to 40ft line, 5ft wide.

values.name: Surfer
values.description: You summon a fast-moving wave in front of you that crashes down on creatures in a {shape}. Any creature caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage and falling prone on a failure, or half as much without falling prone on a success.

values.name: Trefferschwall
values.description: You strike the target three times in a single fluid motion. Make three melee attacks against a single target. On each hit, you deal {dice} {type} damage.

values.name: Angeberei
values.description: Force a target in range to make a {save}. On a fail, the target is confused, but it adds +2 to its attack rolls while confused.

values.name: Verzehrer
values.description: You absorb your Stockpiled energy to heal your wounds. When activated after using Stockpile, regain a base {dice} hit points. The dice roll is doubled if two rounds of energy were Stockpiled. The dice roll is tripled if three rounds of energy were Stockpiled.

values.name: Bitterkuss
values.description: You lay a kiss on a creature, attempting to confuse them. The target must make a {save} or become confused.

values.name: Lockduft
values.description: You release a sweet smell directed at a target in range. The target must make a {save}. On a fail, you have advantage on your next two attacks against that target.
values.optional: Change range to 10ft radius circle centered up to 20ft away. All allies gain the benefit of having advantage against the targets.

values.name: Sternschauer
values.description: You fire two projectiles at any creature you choose in range. They do not have to target the same creature. Each hit for {dice} {type} damage. This move also targets creature during the invulnerable stages of Dig, Fly, Bounce, etc.
values.higherLevels: You fire 4 projectiles at level 5, 5 projectiles at level 10, and 6 projectiles at level 17.

values.name: Wechseldich
values.description: Your hands move with incredible speed as you attempt to switch held items with a creature. Force a creature to make a {save}. On a failure, you take their held item and replace it with your own. If you do not have a held item, you simply take theirs without replacement.

values.name: Swords Dance
values.description: When you activate this move, a sword appears and dances around you, increasing your AC by 1. As a bonus action on a future turn, you may drop concentration to release this sword and roll a ranged attack at a target within 30 feet of you, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.
values.higherLevels: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5. At level 10, you can now create two swords for +2 to AC and two ranged attacks. At level 17, the damage dice for each sword increases to 3d8.

values.name: Synchrolärm
values.description: You emit a strange soundwave that only damages creature that share a type with you. Any creature within 20 feet of you that shares at least one of your types must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

values.name: Synthese
values.description: You regenerate from the inside, healing some of your wounds. Heal yourself for {dice} hit points. If activated in harsh sunlight, double the healing dice.

values.name: Syrup Bomb
values.description:
You set off an explosion of sticky candy syrup at a point within range. Each creature within 5ft of that point must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on failure, half on success. On failure, the creature also falls Prone.

Syrup then covers the ground within 5ft of the target point for the duration. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must make a {save}, falling Prone on failure.

values.name: Tachyon-Schnitt
values.description: You launch particle blades at the opponent twice in a row. This move is guaranteed to hit twice, each for {dice} {type} damage, unless during the invulnerable stage of Fly, Dig, Bounce, Dive, etc. moves.

values.name: Tackle
values.description: You rush forward and slam into a creature. Make a melee attack roll against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Schweifglanz
values.description: Your tail emits a flash of light, boosting your attack. For the duration, double your STAB damage.

values.name: Kehrschelle
values.description: You strike out against a creature with a quick- hitting, hard tail. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 {type} damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.

values.name: Rutenschlag
values.description: You shake your tail at a target, distracting it and opening up its defenses. The creature must make a {save}. On a fail, allies add +1 to any attack they target it with for the duration. This modifier can be stacked if it fails multiple tail whip saves, up to a maximum of +5.

values.name: Rückenwind
values.description: You whip up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the speed of all allies in a {shape}, centered on you. You and any ally that starts their turn inside the area has their speed doubled until the end of their turn.

values.name: Bodycheck
values.description: You sacrifice your own position to take down a creature. Roll a melee attack roll. On a hit, you deal {dice} {type} damage, taking a quarter of the total damage (rounded down) in typeless recoil.

values.name: Take Heart
values.description: As a reaction to receiving a negative Status Condition or becoming Frightened, heal yourself of that Condition and become immune to receiving new Status Conditions or becoming Frightened until the end of your next turn. Additionally, until the end of your next turn, you gain advantage on attack rolls made with WIS or CHA as the Move Power and on all WIS or CHA saving throws.

values.name: Teerschuss
values.description:
You lob sticky tar at the target. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage. On a hit, the target's speed is reduced by 10ft for the rest of the encounter. This decrease may be stacked until the creature's speed becomes 0.

Additionally, while affected by tar, the target has vulnerability to fire damage. If it was resistant, it now takes normal damage. If it was immune, it remains immune.

The target may take an action to remove any tar from its face, resetting the effect.

values.name: Verhöhner
values.description: You taunt a creature to only attack you with damaging attacks. Choose a target in range and force it to make a {save}. On a failure, the target can only use damaging attacks that target you for the duration.

values.name: Tränendrüse
values.description: You fill your eyes with tears to make all creatures in range lose their combative spirit.  All creatures in range must make a {save}.  On a fail, they add -1 to any attack they makes for the duration.  This modifier can be stacked if an affected creature fails multiple Tearful Look saves, up to a maximum of -5.

values.name: Teatime
values.description: It's tea time! All creatures in range must make a {save}. On a fail, the creature must spend its next action consuming its held berry. This move has no effect on the creature if it is not holding a berry. You also immediately consume your held berry. Outside of combat, this move may be used once during a short rest to grant each ally one free hit die of recovery.

values.name: Techblaster
values.description: You fire a powerful beam of pure light. The line is 80 feet long and 5 feet wide, and all creatues caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. The damage type is dependant on the Drive the user holds. (Burn Drive - Fire, Chill Drive - Ice, Douse Drive - Water, Shock Drive - Electric)

values.name: Taumeltanz
values.description: You start to perform a difficult dance, confusing all creatures in range. Creatures within 20 feet of you must make a {save}, becoming confused on a fail.

values.name: Telekinese
values.description: You use your psychic power to attempt to hold a creature above the ground, making it vulnerable to attacks. Force a creature in range to make a {save}. On a failure, the creature is grappled and restrained for the duration, unable to release itself as long as you hold your concentration. While grappled, the creature is considered Raised.

values.name: Teleport
values.description: You disappear from view and reappear at an unoccupied point within range. In wild creature battles, this move can be activated to automatically count as a single success in a group DEX check to run away.

values.name: Frustflamme
values.description: Spurred by desperation, you attack the target. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If you missed an attack roll last turn, then add an additional damage die to your damage roll.

values.name: Tera Blast
values.description: You unleash the power of your tera type as a focused beam of elemental energy. Make a ranged attack against a creature, doing {dice} damage on hit. If you are terastallized, the type of this damage is the same as your tera type. Otherwise, it is normal.

values.name: Tera-Sternhagel
values.description:
With the power of your crystals, you bombard and eliminate the target. Choose a point you can see within range. Each creature in a 20ft radius sphere centered on the point makes a {save}. A creature takes {dice} {type} damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful save.

Only Terapagos may use this move. If Terapagos is in its Stellar Form, then you may choose four points instead of one. A creature in an area of more than one tera sphere is affected only once.

Terastallized Pokémon are vulnerable to stellar-type damage. Otherwise, all creatures of any type take normal damage.

values.name: Feldimpuls
values.description:
You utilize the energy of the terrain to attack. When you are within the effects of a special terrain, you can target any number of creatures subject to the same terrain (up to a maximum range of 120ft). Each target creature makes a {save}, taking {dice} damage on failure or half on success. The type of damage dealt depends on the type of terrain.

If you are not subject to any special terrain, then the range of this move is Self (30ft radius).

values.name: Raub
values.description: You lash out with a quick attack that may steal a creature’s held item. Make a melee attack against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the user does not have an item held, the target must make a {save} or have their item stolen by the user.

values.name: Tausend Pfeile
values.description: You summon forth a volley of green arrows to pierce creatures in range. All creatures in a {shape}, centered on a point within range, must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a hit, or half as much on a save. Flying-type creatures or ones with Levitate, Magnet Rise, or similar ability CAN be hit by this move. Any creature that fails the saving throw falls to the ground and is now grounded. Grounded creatures are susceptible to to ground-type moves until they raise up, regardless of their type or ability.

values.name: Tausend Wellen
values.description: A wave of green energy courses through the battlefield in a {shape}, centered on you. Any creature caught in the wave must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Any creature that fails the saving throw cannot flee or be switched out as long as you remain in battle.

values.name: Fuchtler
values.description: You thrash about wildly, doing several attacks without control. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d10 {type} damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of two additional hits. At the end of this attack, you become confused.

values.name: Neck Strike
values.description: You focus in on an attack at the target’s throat. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On hit, the target is unable to activate sound-based moves for its next 1d4 turns.
values.optional: On a hit, the target is unable to perform spells with verbal components for the same number of turns.

values.name: Donner
values.description: Powerful electric energy arcs out from you, hitting any creature in a {shape}, centered on you. Creatures caught in the area must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, and half as much on a success. Creatures that fail the saving throw by 5 or more become paralyzed. Creatures in range that are in flight or in the invulnerable stage of Fly or Bounce take double damage from this move.

values.name: Blitzgefängnis
values.description: You create a cage of electricity that envelopes a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and is restrained. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a {save}. On each successive turn, if the creature is still restrained, you may use this move again (as an action) and automatically hit.

values.name: Donnerzahn
values.description: You attempt to pierce a creature with electric fangs. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is paralyzed and flinches.

values.name: Donnerschlag
values.description: Your punches are imbued with electric energy. Make a melee attack on a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is paralyzed.

values.name: Donnerschock
values.description: You deliver an electric shock to a target in range. Make a ranged attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Donnerwelle
values.description: You send a wave of electric energy that surrounds a creature in range. The target must make a {save} or become paralyzed.

values.name: Donnerblitz
values.description: You send a powerful bolt of electricity at a target in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is paralyzed.

values.name: Sturmblitz
values.description: As a reaction to being attacked with a ranged attack by a creature you can see in range, you may strike first with a jolt of electricity. Make a ranged attack against the attacker, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Your roll happens before theirs.

values.name: Donnernder Tritt
values.description: You overwhelm the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. Make a melee attack against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the target must make a {save}, being knocked prone and knocked back up to 15 ft on failure.

values.name: Spaßkanone
values.description: You turn your melee attack into a playful tickle. As a bonus action at the end of a turn in which you used a melee attack, force a creature to make a {save}. On a failure, the target flinches.

values.name: Tidy Up
values.description:
You do whatever it takes to keep this space clean. Until the end of your next turn, the next attack roll you make is made with advantage. Creatures of your choice within 80ft of you that you can see and are under the effect of Substitute must make a {save}, ending Substitute's effects on a failed save.

For the next minute, whenever a creature you can see within 80ft of you uses Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, or Substitute, you may use your reaction to force the creature to make a {save}. On a failed save, the move dissapates with no effect; the creature still spends a PP using their move.

Tidy Up's effect on its user persists even when switched out of combat. You may invoke Tidy Up's reaction even as you are being switched out or switched in. For example, if an enemy uses Spikes as a reaction to you switching out, you may invoke Tidy Up's reaction to attempt to dissapate Spikes before the switch completes.

values.name: Invertigo
values.description: You unleash a dark energy that has the power to reverse the stat changes of a creature. Force a creature in range to make a {save}. On a failure, any stat changes currently affecting the target have the opposite effect.

values.name: Torch Song
values.description: You blow out raging flames whilst singing a song. Choose any number of creatures within a {shape}. Each creature must make a {save}. On a failure, the creature takes {dice} {type} damage, half on success. The DC for this move increases by 1 for each consecutive turn it is used, up to a maximum of +5, and resets after not being used for a turn.

values.name: Folterknecht
values.description: You send a dark energy to torment a creature in range that attacks you. When hit by a melee or ranged attack, force the target to make a {save}. On a failure, the target cannot use the same move that hit you on its next turn.

values.name: Toxin
values.description: You send a downpour of potent, poisonous rain in a 5 foot radius, centered on a point within range. Targets in the area must make a {save} or become badly poisoned.

values.name: Giftspitzen
values.description: You quickly summon a trap of poisonous spikes around a creature that enters the battle. When a creature is switched into battle, you may use your reaction to force a creature to make a {save}, becoming poisoned on a failure. If the creature fails by 5 or more, it becomes badly poisoned instead.

values.name: Giftfaden
values.description: You fire a collection of poisonous threads at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll against a target, covering them with threads on a hit. So long as the threads make contact with the target, the target is poisoned and its speed is reduced by 10. This move is stackable to any amount however the poison effect does not affect the target more than once. If this reduction in speed causes their speed to be 0, the target is restrained. The target may use an action to remove the threads from its body, healing the poisoned status.

values.name: Trailblaze
values.description: You attack suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. With each successful hit from this move, increase your movement speed by 5 until you are incapacitated, are switched out, or the combat ends. (Maximum of +30 to movement speed)

values.name: Wandler
values.description: You attempt to morph into a near-exact copy of a creature in range. The base SR of the target must be able to be controlled by your trainer or the move fails. For the duration, you copy the target's type, ability scores, AC, skills, speeds, senses, abilities, and current moves. You retain your own feats, level, and HP (Changed CON does not impact your HP).

values.name: Triplette
values.description: You strike with a simultaneous three-beam attack. Each creature in a {shape}, centered on you, must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, and half as much on a success. Targets that fail the save by 5 or more must roll a d6, gaining the status condition as follows:

values.name: Trickbetrug
values.description: You move quickly to attempt to swap held items with a creature. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, swapping held items with them on a hit.

values.name: Bizarroraum
