values.description: The world around you seems to spin for a moment, and the whole battlefield is hit with a bizarre feeling. Starting at the beginning of the next round of combat after you activate this move, the initiative order is permanently reversed.

values.name: Halloween
values.description: You attempt to scare the spirit right out of a creature in range. Force a creature in range to make a {save}. On a failure, its type is changed to Ghost through their next three turns in battle.

values.name: Triple Arrows
values.description:
You fire three arrows at the target. Make three ranged attacks against the same target in range, each dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

The first attack critical hits on nat 19s and 20s. The second attack lowers the target's AC by 1 if it hits until the end of combat (stacks up to 5 times). The third attack flinches the target on a hit.

values.name: Dreifach-Axel
values.description: You strike out with three consecutive kicks. Make three melee attack rolls in order, doing {dice} {type} damage on each hit. As soon as one attack misses, the move is over.

values.name: Triple Dive
values.description: You perform a perfectly timed triple dive. Make three melee attack rolls against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on each hit.

values.name: Dreifachkick
values.description: You strike out with three consecutive kicks. Make three melee attack rolls in order, doing {dice} {type} damage on each hit. As soon as one attack misses, the move is over.

values.name: Tropenkick
values.description: You attempt to land an intense kick of tropical origins on the target.  Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural roll of 16 or more, the target adds -1 to any attack it makes for the remainder of combat.  This modifier can be stacked up to a maximum of -3.

values.name: Trumpfkarte
values.description: You strike out with a blast of energy that increases in strength the more it is used. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Increase the damage by your Move modifier for each PP that has been expended for the move, before the move was activated. Using a restorative to regain PP resets the damage for this attack.

values.name: Twin Beam
values.description: You shoot mystical beams from your eyes. Make two ranged attack rolls against a target, doing {dice} {type} damage on each hit.

values.name: Duonadel
values.description: You fire two sharp projectiles at a creature in range. They do not have to target the same creature. Make two ranged attack rolls, dealing {dice} {type} damage on each hit. If the natural roll of either attack is a 19 or 20, the target is poisoned.

values.name: Windhose
values.description: You send a gust of swirling wind that tears through a creature. Make a ranged attack on a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 16 or higher, the target flinches.

values.name: Kehrtwende
values.description: You lash out with a quick strike before you make a getaway. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After this move is activated, a trainer must switch out the user as a free action.

values.name: Schnellkonter
values.description: You react to the target's movement and strike with the heel of your palm. When targeted by a melee attack, you may use your reaction to attempt to strike a creature before its attack is rolled. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Aufruhr
values.description: You cause an uproar on the battlefield in a {shape}, centered on you, for three rounds of combat. During the uproar, your action is spent continuing the move (without spending PP), and any creature in range wakes and is prevented from falling asleep. (This include creatures that would purposefully fall asleep using moves like Rest) In addition, creatures in the area at the start of their turns must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, or half as much on a success.

values.name: V-Generator
values.description: Your forehead burns like hot coals as you slam your head into a creature. Make a melee attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After activating this move, your AC decreases by 2 until the beginning of your next turn.

values.name: Vakuumwelle
values.description: You whirl your fists with a fast attack that pushes a quick burst of wind at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Giftfalle
values.description: You drench a creature with an odd, poisonous liquid. Force a creature to make a {save}, becoming poisoned on a failure. If the target is already poisoned, this move automatically hits, and the target replaces its poisoned condition with badly poisoned.

values.name: Giftschock
values.description: You attempt to drench a creature in poisonous liquid. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target is already poisoned, double the dice roll for the damage

values.name: Klammer
values.description: You crush a creature with a forceful, gripping attack. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit, grappling the target. On each successive turn, if the creature is still grappled, you may use this move again (as an action) and automatically hit. A creature may attempt to escape the grapple at the beginning of its turns with a {save}.

values.name: Victory Dance
values.description: You perform an intense dance to usher victory. For the duration, add +1 to your AC, attack rolls, and saving throws.
values.higherLevels: Add +2 to your AC, attack rolls, and saving throws at level 10 and above

values.name: Rankenhieb
values.description: You extend a sharp vine to whip the target with. This vine can strike anything within 15 feet of you. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Überwurf
values.description: A slow fighting attack that pummels a creature. As an action on your turn, you hold this move until next turn, where it will automatically hit for {dice} {type} damage as long as the target remains in melee range.

values.name: Voltwechsel
values.description: You lash out with a quick, electric strike before you make a getaway. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After this move is activated, a trainer must switch out the user as a free action.

values.name: Volttackle
values.description: You electrify yourself and then charge at the target. When activating this move, you flash forward 15 feet and make a melee attack roll against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, you also take a quarter of the total (rounded down) in typeless recoil damage.

values.name: Weckruf
values.description: You attack with a jolting slap from your palms. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target is asleep, double your Move modifier when adding damage, but the target automatically wakes up.

values.name: Aquaknarre
values.description: You fire a quick spurt of water at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Wassersäulen
values.description: You send a column of water towards a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After you land a hit, any ally that uses another Pledge move in the same round automatically hits.

values.name: Aquawelle
values.description: You send a wave of ultrasonic aquatic energy at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 17 or higher, the target is confused.

values.name: Wasser-Shuriken
values.description: You fire a barrage of sharp shurikens at a target. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, another shuriken strikes the target for an additional 1d4 {type} damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.

values.name: Nassmacher
values.description: You soak yourself and all allies with water, reducing the amount of fire damage taken for anyone affected. For the duration, you and any ally in range (when you initially activated this move) have resistance to fire-type attacks. If an affected creature was already resistant, it is now immune. If it was vulnerable, it now takes normal damage. If it was immune to fire-type moves already, nothing happens.

values.name: Fontränen
values.description: You fire a blast of water at a creature that increases in power the more healthy you are. Make a ranged attack roll against a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit if you are at or above 50% of your health. If you are below 50%, halve the total damage done.

values.name: Kaskade
values.description: You create an intense waterfall that crashes down on creatures in a 10 foot radius, centered on a point within range. Creatures in the area must make a {save} or take {dice} {type} damage and fall prone on a fail, or half as much on a save.

values.name: Wave Crash
values.description: You shroud yourself in water and slam into the target with your full body. Roll a melee attack roll. On a hit, you deal {dice} {type} damage, taking half of the total damage (rounded down) in typeless recoil.

values.name: Meteorologe
values.description: You send a powerful ball of energy that changes type based on the surrounding weather. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} normal damage on a hit. If any of the following weather conditions are active, then double the damage dice and change the type of damage to the respective type indicated in the table.

values.name: Whirlpool
values.description: You create a wave of water that swirls around a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and is restrained. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a {save}. On each successive turn, if the creature is still restrained, you may use this move again (as an action) and automatically hit.

values.name: Wirbelwind
values.description: You create a whirlwind of spinning air around you, increasing your AC by +2 until the beginning of your next turn. When you activate this move, any creature within 5 feet of you must succeed on a {save} or fall prone. In wild creature battles, this move can be activated to automatically count as a single success in a group DEX check to run away.

values.name: Finstertreffer
values.description: You strike the target with a single, fierce blow. Make a melee attack. On a hit, you deal {dice} {type} damage.

values.name: Rundumschutz
values.description: You have the ability to guard your allies from area-of-effect moves. As a reaction, when a creature activates a damaging move that damages multiple allies within range, you may halve the damage dealt. On future instances of this reaction in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll or forfeit the reaction with no effect

values.name: Wildbolt Storm
values.description:
You create a thunderous tempest which savagely attacks with lightning and wind with the size of a 40-foot-cube centered on a point in range. Each enemy creature in the area makes a {save}. On a failed save, it takes {dice} {type} damage and becomes Paralyzed. On a successful save, it takes half the damage and does not become Paralyzed.

A creature also makes that save if it enters the area or ends it turn there. A creature makes that save only once per turn.

When used during the rain, creatures have disadvantage on the save.

values.name: Stromstoß
values.description: You shroud yourself in electricity and charge at a creature. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit, but taking 1/4 of the damage (rounded down) in typeless recoil.

values.name: Irrlicht
values.description: You send a sinister, white-hot flame at a creature attempting to inflict a burn. Make a ranged attack roll on a target, causing burn on a hit.

values.name: Flügelschlag
values.description: You strike out at a target creature with your wings. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Wunschtraum
values.description: You send forth a healing wish that takes time to come true. At the end of your next turn, as a free action, heal a target in range for {dice} hit points.

values.name: Panzerschutz
values.description: When subject to a melee or ranged attack, you can spend your reaction to increase your AC by +2 if it would cause the attack to miss.
values.higherLevels: Increase your AC by +3 at level 10 and above.

values.name: Wunderraum
values.description: You create a bizarre vibe in the air in a {shape}, centered on you. For the duration, all WIS saves become CON saves and all CON saves become WIS saves.

values.name: Holzhammer
values.description: You slam your rough body against a creature, taking serious recoil damage. Make an attack roll against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, you also take a quarter of the damage dealt in typeless recoil damage.

values.name: Kraftschub
values.description: You get your adrenaline pumping and go into a frenzy. While worked up, you add +2 to all attack rolls. Your worked up status ends if you are incapacitated or if your turn ends and you have not attacked a hostile target since your last turn, or taken any damage since then.

values.name: Sorgensamen
values.description: You shoot a bizarre seed that implants worry into another creature. The target must succeed on a {save} or replace the user's choice of ability with Insomnia, preventing sleep for the duration.

values.name: Wickel
values.description: You attempt to grapple a target into submission. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and is grappled. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a {save}. As long as the target is grappled on your subsequent turns, this move can be activated again as a bonus action with an automatic hit, dealing 1d4 {type} damage.

values.name: Auswringen
values.description: You wrap your hands around the target and squeeze hard. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the target has 50% or more of its maximum HP, double your move modifier for the damage roll.

values.name: Kreuzschere
values.description: You cross your claws for a scissor-like slashing attack. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

values.name: Gähner
values.description: You release a big yawn that causes a creature to become very drowsy. Choose a target in range. If that target is still in the battle at the end of its next turn, it falls asleep.

values.name: Blitzkanone
values.description: You fire out an extreme blast of pure electric energy at a creature. Make a ranged attack against a target in range, doing {dice} {type} damage. If the natural attack roll is 15 or higher, the target is paralyzed.

values.name: Zen-Kopfstoß
values.description: You focus all of your willpower into your head and ram it into a creature. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 17 or higher, the target flinches.

values.name: Elektropikser
values.description: A strong electric blast crashes down on two unique targets in range, giving them an electric shock.  Make two ranged attacks, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.  If the natural attack roll is 18 or higher, the target flinches.
